raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Split [#44530](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44530) into five review layers. This is layer 3/5, now based on `main` after [#44665](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44665) merged.

## Modifications

Adds Muse Spark text and Omni runtime support, multimodal processing, MoE and quantization integration, runtime defaults, shared runtime updates, and registered tests. AMD-specific hunks and the #224 megakernel integration/tests are deferred to their respective layers.

This layer changes **82 files (+9,175 / -224)** relative to its immediate base. Every split commit preserves all 32 `Co-authored-by` trailers from the original commit.

## Validation

- Temporarily disabled the CI registration for `test_muse_spark_12_b300_pd.py` until **2026-11-01**. [B300 job 117611788593](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39099912264/job/117611788593) failed during server startup and ran zero tests: the log shows whole-model Hugging Face cache cleanup immediately before tokenizer loading failed, consistent with a concurrent cache cleanup race. [#44975](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44975) is a one-file follow-up based on this PR that restores the registration; the cache issue still needs validation or a fix before merging that follow-up. CI registry parsing and pre-commit passed for both changes.
- Fixed the earlier failures in [Base run 39006509622](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39006509622) and [Extra run 39006509690](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39006509690): CUDA-decoded video tensors no longer go through CPU pinning; CuTeDSL/CUTLASS preserve Standard combine output for all-gather prefill; runtime group accessors, test fixtures, the model-default whitelist and the custom multimodal executor declaration are aligned.
- Set Muse Spark B300 speculative decoding speed to **500 token/s**; kept the **4.7** acceptance thresholds. The benchmark now flushes both PD workers directly with checked POST requests instead of ignoring mini-LB 405 responses.
- Five complete targeted unit-test files passed: **594 tests**, covering runtime context, server arguments, FlashInfer dispatch/runners, multimodal async call sites and model overrides. Added prefill/idle/decode format and workspace regression cases. Pre-commit and Python compilation passed; these local results do not imply that every GitHub CI suite has passed.
- On a 4x B200 devbox with the same Torch 2.14.1, Transformers 5.19.0 and FlashInfer 0.7.2 versions as CI, reproduced the original CuTeDSL and CUDA pin-memory errors before applying the patch. After the patch, real CPU/CUDA video preprocessing and the original Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-Omni video-chat tests passed.
- The original Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 TP4/EP4/DP4 CuTeDSL + FlashInfer server configuration booted successfully and passed six checked serial/concurrent generation requests. This is a smoke test; the full 1,319-question GSM8K suite remains for CI.
- Localized the Qwen3-Omni prefix-cache wording mismatch to Blackwell BF16 split-K numerics: six fixed-seed cold/cache comparisons failed on the default path, while six passed with only split-K disabled; the original base passed on two B200 GPUs. Moved the exact-equality case to a dedicated deterministic + Triton-attention fixture with radix caching explicitly enabled; kept the other nine modality tests on production defaults. The complete updated Qwen3-Omni file passed **10/10 tests** in 167 seconds. No output assertions were relaxed or test cases removed.
- The 8x B300 Muse Spark performance/accuracy suite was not rerun locally: no whole-node B300 capacity was available. Its latest CI attempt failed before reaching accuracy or throughput assertions. The temporary skip changes scheduling only; all test cases and thresholds remain intact.
- Preserved all user follow-up commits and all 32 original coauthor trailers. AMD and Helion changes remain in layers 4/5 and 5/5.

## Stack

Merge/review order, from `main` upward:

1. [#44664](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44664) — CUDA Docker and DeepGEMM patches (**merged**)
2. [#44665](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44665) — Kernels and collective GEMM (**merged**)
3. [#44666](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44666) — SRT and registered tests
4. [#44667](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44667) — AMD / ROCm support
5. [#44668](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44668) — Helion verify megakernels (#224)

The original #44530 remains unchanged as the full-stack reference.

detail.body:
## Motivation

Split [#44530](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44530) into five review layers. This is layer 3/5, now based on `main` after [#44665](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44665) merged.

## Modifications

Adds Muse Spark text and Omni runtime support, multimodal processing, MoE and quantization integration, runtime defaults, shared runtime updates, and registered tests. AMD-specific hunks and the #224 megakernel integration/tests are deferred to their respective layers.

This layer changes **82 files (+9,175 / -224)** relative to its immediate base. Every split commit preserves all 32 `Co-authored-by` trailers from the original commit.

## Validation

- Temporarily disabled the CI registration for `test_muse_spark_12_b300_pd.py` until **2026-11-01**. [B300 job 117611788593](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39099912264/job/117611788593) failed during server startup and ran zero tests: the log shows whole-model Hugging Face cache cleanup immediately before tokenizer loading failed, consistent with a concurrent cache cleanup race. [#44975](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44975) is a one-file follow-up based on this PR that restores the registration; the cache issue still needs validation or a fix before merging that follow-up. CI registry parsing and pre-commit passed for both changes.
- Fixed the earlier failures in [Base run 39006509622](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39006509622) and [Extra run 39006509690](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39006509690): CUDA-decoded video tensors no longer go through CPU pinning; CuTeDSL/CUTLASS preserve Standard combine output for all-gather prefill; runtime group accessors, test fixtures, the model-default whitelist and the custom multimodal executor declaration are aligned.
- Set Muse Spark B300 speculative decoding speed to **500 token/s**; kept the **4.7** acceptance thresholds. The benchmark now flushes both PD workers directly with checked POST requests instead of ignoring mini-LB 405 responses.
- Five complete targeted unit-test files passed: **594 tests**, covering runtime context, server arguments, FlashInfer dispatch/runners, multimodal async call sites and model overrides. Added prefill/idle/decode format and workspace regression cases. Pre-commit and Python compilation passed; these local results do not imply that every GitHub CI suite has passed.
- On a 4x B200 devbox with the same Torch 2.14.1, Transformers 5.19.0 and FlashInfer 0.7.2 versions as CI, reproduced the original CuTeDSL and CUDA pin-memory errors before applying the patch. After the patch, real CPU/CUDA video preprocessing and the original Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-Omni video-chat tests passed.
- The original Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 TP4/EP4/DP4 CuTeDSL + FlashInfer server configuration booted successfully and passed six checked serial/concurrent generation requests. This is a smoke test; the full 1,319-question GSM8K suite remains for CI.
- Localized the Qwen3-Omni prefix-cache wording mismatch to Blackwell BF16 split-K numerics: six fixed-seed cold/cache comparisons failed on the default path, while six passed with only split-K disabled; the original base passed on two B200 GPUs. Moved the exact-equality case to a dedicated deterministic + Triton-attention fixture with radix caching explicitly enabled; kept the other nine modality tests on production defaults. The complete updated Qwen3-Omni file passed **10/10 tests** in 167 seconds. No output assertions were relaxed or test cases removed.
- The 8x B300 Muse Spark performance/accuracy suite was not rerun locally: no whole-node B300 capacity was available. Its latest CI attempt failed before reaching accuracy or throughput assertions. The temporary skip changes scheduling only; all test cases and thresholds remain intact.
- Preserved all user follow-up commits and all 32 original coauthor trailers. AMD and Helion changes remain in layers 4/5 and 5/5.

## Stack

Merge/review order, from `main` upward:

1. [#44664](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44664) — CUDA Docker and DeepGEMM patches (**merged**)
2. [#44665](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44665) — Kernels and collective GEMM (**merged**)
3. [#44666](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44666) — SRT and registered tests
4. [#44667](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44667) — AMD / ROCm support
5. [#44668](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44668) — Helion verify megakernels (#224)

The original #44530 remains unchanged as the full-stack reference.

+def _muse_spark_arch_of(hf_config: Any) -> str | None:
+    architectures = getattr(hf_config, "architectures", None) or []

+    return arch if arch in MUSE_SPARK_ARCHITECTURES else None

+def apply_muse_spark_env_defaults(server_args: Any) -> None:
+    """Muse Spark environment defaults; an explicit value in the environment wins.
+
+    Runs before handle_gpu_memory_settings, whose mem-fraction heuristic reads
+    the post-capture switch.
+    """
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if parse_connector_type(cfg.model_path) == ConnectorType.INSTANCE:
+        return
+    hf_config = get_config(
+        cfg.model_path,
+        trust_remote_code=cfg.trust_remote_code,
+        revision=cfg.revision,
+        model_config_parser=cfg.model_config_parser,
+    )
+    arch = _muse_spark_arch_of(hf_config)
+    if arch is None:
+        return
+
+    applied = []
+    for field, value in MUSE_SPARK_ENV_DEFAULTS:
+        if not field.is_set():
+            field.set(value)
+            applied.append(f"{field.name}={value}")
+    # The serialized NVFP4 checkpoint carries per-token activation scales.
+    if (
+        cfg.quantization == "modelopt_fp4"
+        and not envs.SGLANG_FLASHINFER_NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_ACTIVATION.is_set()
+    ):
+        envs.SGLANG_FLASHINFER_NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_ACTIVATION.set(True)
+        applied.append("SGLANG_FLASHINFER_NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_ACTIVATION=True")
+    if applied:
+        logger.info(f"{arch} environment defaults: {' '.join(applied)}")
+
+
+def muse_spark_chat_template_default(server_args: Any) -> str | None:
+    """The checkpoint's Jinja chat template when --chat-template is not set.
+
+    Reads the memoised model configuration only, like the architecture parser
+    defaults it is declared next to.
+    """
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if cfg.chat_template is not None:
+        return None
+    model_config = getattr(server_args, "_model_config", None)
+    if model_config is None:
+        return None
+    arch = _muse_spark_arch_of(model_config.hf_config)
+    if arch is None:
+        return None
+    template = _checkpoint_file(model_config, MUSE_SPARK_CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE)
+    if template is not None:
+        logger.info(f"Defaulting --chat-template to '{template}' for {arch}.")
+        return template
+    logger.warning(
+        f"{arch} checkpoint has no {MUSE_SPARK_CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE}; "
+        "--chat-template stays unset."
+    )
+    return None
+
+
+def _checkpoint_file(model_config: Any, filename: str) -> str | None:
+    model_path = getattr(model_config, "model_path", None)
+    if not model_path:
+        return None
+    if os.path.isdir(model_path):
+        candidate = os.path.join(model_path, filename)
+        return candidate if os.path.isfile(candidate) else None
+    try:
+        from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
+
+        return hf_hub_download(
+            repo_id=model_path,
+            filename=filename,
+            revision=getattr(model_config, "revision", None),
+        )
+    except (OSError, ValueError, ImportError):
+        return None

+"""Torch-native waveform encoder used by Muse 1.2 Omni checkpoints."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.muse_spark import MuseSparkAudioConfig
+
+
+class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, eps: float = 1e-6) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size))
+        self.eps = eps
+
+    def forward(self, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return F.rms_norm(value, (value.shape[-1],), self.weight, self.eps)
+
+
+def patchify(value: torch.Tensor, patch_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    batch, length, channels = value.shape
+    if length % patch_size:
+        raise ValueError(f"audio length {length} is not divisible by {patch_size}")
+    return value.reshape(batch, length // patch_size, patch_size * channels)
+
+
+class Patchifier(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self, patch_size: int, input_size: int, output_size: int, eps: float
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.patch_size = patch_size
+        self.proj = nn.Linear(input_size * patch_size, output_size, bias=True)
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(output_size, eps)
+
+    def forward(self, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.norm(self.proj(patchify(value, self.patch_size)))
+
+
+class DepthwiseCausalConv(nn.Conv1d):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, kernel_size: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            hidden_size, hidden_size, kernel_size, groups=hidden_size, bias=True
+        )
+        self.causal_kernel_size = kernel_size
+
+    def forward(
+        self, value: torch.Tensor, cache: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
+        value = value.transpose(1, 2)
+        if cache is None:
+            value = F.pad(value, (self.causal_kernel_size - 1, 0))
+            new_cache = None
+        else:
+            value = torch.cat((cache, value), dim=-1)
+            new_cache = value[:, :, -self.causal_kernel_size + 1 :]
+        return super().forward(value).transpose(1, 2), new_cache
+
+
+class Block(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self, hidden_size: int, intermediate_size: int, kernel_size: int, eps: float

+        cache2 = torch.empty(
+            (num_tokens * topk, size_n),
+            device=hidden_states.device,
+            dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
+        )
+        cache13 = torch.empty(
+            (num_tokens * topk * max(gemm1_n, size_k),),
+            device=hidden_states.device,
+            dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
+        )
+        cache1 = cache13[: num_tokens * topk * gemm1_n].view(-1, gemm1_n)
+        cache3 = cache13[: num_tokens * topk * size_k].view(-1, size_k)
+
+        cache1 = moe_wna16_marlin_gemm(
+            hidden_states,
+            cache1,
+            self.w13_weight,
+            None,
+            self.w13_weight_scale,
+            self.w13_weight_scale_2,
+            None,
+            None,
+            None,
+            workspace,
+            sorted_token_ids,
+            expert_ids,
+            num_tokens_post_padded,
+            topk_weights,
+            moe_block_size=block_size_m,
+            top_k=topk,
+            mul_topk_weights=False,
+            is_ep=expert_map is not None,
+            b_q_type=scalar_types.float4_e2m1f,

+            size_n=gemm1_n,
+            size_k=size_k,
+            is_k_full=True,
+            use_atomic_add=False,
+            use_fp32_reduce=True,
+            is_zp_float=False,

+        silu_and_mul(
+            cache1.view(-1, gemm1_n),
+            cache2,

+            cache2,
+            cache3,
+            self.w2_weight,
+            None,
+            self.w2_weight_scale,
+            self.w2_weight_scale_2,
+            None,
+            None,
+            None,
+            workspace,
+            sorted_token_ids,
+            expert_ids,
+            num_tokens_post_padded,
+            topk_weights,
+            moe_block_size=block_size_m,
+            top_k=1,
+            mul_topk_weights=False,
+            is_ep=expert_map is not None,
+            b_q_type=scalar_types.float4_e2m1f,

+    def _forward_marlin(

+                "The NVFP4 Marlin fallback requires moe_use_post_expert_norm=True. "
+                "Marlin carries one NVFP4 global scale per expert, so "
+                "w13_weight_scale_2 is collapsed to its gate column and every "
+                "expert output picks up a constant gain 1/r with "
+                "r = w3_weight_scale_2 / w1_weight_scale_2. The post-expert "
+                "RMSNorm cancels that gain exactly; without it the expert "
+                "outputs are mis-scaled per expert. Run this checkpoint on "
+                "SM100+ with --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm instead."

+            hidden_states = pre_expert_norm(hidden_states)

+                eps=self._post_expert_norm_eps,
+                weight_first=self._post_expert_norm_weight_first,
+                slot_expert_ids=local_topk_ids,
+            )

+            expert_outputs=expert_outputs,
+            topk_scores=topk_scores,
+            post_expert_norm=post_expert_norm,
+            out_dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
+        )
+
+    def prepare_input(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        pre_expert_norm: Optional[nn.Module] = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
+        """Normalize and FP4-quantize activations. Does not depend on routing."""
+        seq_len, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
+        if pre_expert_norm is not None and self.quant_config.use_per_token_activation:
+            hs_fp4, hs_scale_linear, per_token_scale, _ = fused_norm_fp4_quant(
+                hidden_states,
+                self._pre_norm_weight(pre_expert_norm),
+                pre_expert_norm.eps,
+                _NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_SCALE_INV,
+            )
+        elif self.quant_config.use_per_token_activation:
+            # Calibration-free checkpoints ship activation scales of exactly 1.0,
+            # so the scale has to be computed per token at runtime instead.
+            from flashinfer import SfLayout, nvfp4_quantize
+
+            global_scale_inv = torch.full(
+                (1,),
+                _NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_SCALE_INV,
+                dtype=torch.float32,
+                device=hidden_states.device,
+            )
+            hs_fp4_bytes, hs_sf_bytes, per_token_scale = nvfp4_quantize(
+                hidden_states,
+                global_scale_inv,
+                sfLayout=SfLayout.layout_linear,
+                per_token_activation=True,
+                backend="cute-dsl",
+            )

+            hs_fp4 = hs_fp4_bytes.reshape(seq_len, hidden_size // 2)
+            hs_scale_linear = hs_sf_bytes.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(
+                seq_len, hidden_size // 16
+            )
+        else:
+            if pre_expert_norm is not None:
+                hidden_states = pre_expert_norm(hidden_states)
+            # Match the known-good public vLLM activation path. SGLang's
+            # helper selects FlashInfer's experimental CuTeDSL quantizer on
+            # SM100, while vLLM's scaled_fp4_quant uses the stable CUDA
+            # implementation with a linear scale-factor layout.
+            from flashinfer import fp4_quantize
+
+            per_token_scale = None
+            hs_fp4_bytes, hs_sf_bytes = fp4_quantize(
+                hidden_states,
+                self.w13_input_scale_quant,
+                sf_vec_size=16,
+                sf_use_ue8m0=False,
+                is_sf_swizzled_layout=False,
+                backend="cuda",
+            )

+            hs_fp4 = hs_fp4_bytes.reshape(seq_len, hidden_size // 2)
+            hs_scale_linear = hs_sf_bytes.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(
+                seq_len, hidden_size // 16
+            )

+            *hs_scale_linear.shape[:-1], -1
+        )
+        return hs_fp4, hs_scale, per_token_scale
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_scores: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        post_expert_norm: Optional[nn.Module],
+        pre_expert_norm: Optional[nn.Module] = None,
+        packed_topk_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        prepared_input: Optional[
+            tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]
+        ] = None,
+        *,
+        ar_workspace: FinalizePushWorkspace | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.use_marlin:
+            return self._forward_marlin(
+                hidden_states,
+                topk_scores,
+                topk_ids,
+                post_expert_norm,
+                pre_expert_norm=pre_expert_norm,
+            )
+
+        from flashinfer.fused_moe import trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe
+
+        num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if num_tokens == 0:
+            return hidden_states.new_zeros((0, self.hidden_size))
+        if prepared_input is None:
+            prepared_input = self.prepare_input(hidden_states, pre_expert_norm)
+        hs_fp4, hs_scale, per_token_scale = prepared_input
+        # Preserve Muse's packed fast path; the upstream FlashInfer API also
+        # accepts materialized IDs and FP32 routing weights directly.
+        routing = packed_topk_ids
+        if routing is None:
+            routing = (
+                topk_ids.to(torch.int32).contiguous(),
+                topk_scores.to(torch.float32).contiguous(),
+            )
+
+        gemm2_out, expert_weights, expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx = (
+            trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe(
+                topk_ids=routing,
+                routing_bias=None,
+                hidden_states=hs_fp4,
+                hidden_states_scale=hs_scale,
+                gemm1_weights=self.gate_up_proj,
+                gemm1_weights_scale=self.gate_up_proj_weight_scale.view(
+                    torch.float8_e4m3fn
+                ),
+                gemm1_bias=None,
+                gemm1_alpha=getattr(self, "gemm1_alpha", None),
+                gemm1_beta=getattr(self, "gemm1_beta", None),
+                gemm1_clamp_limit=getattr(self, "gemm1_clamp_limit", None),
+                gemm2_weights=self.down_proj,
+                gemm2_weights_scale=self.down_proj_weight_scale.view(
+                    torch.float8_e4m3fn
+                ),
+                gemm2_bias=None,
+                output1_scale_scalar=self.g1_scale_c,
+                output1_scale_gate_scalar=self.g1_alphas,
+                output2_scale_scalar=self.g2_alphas,
+                per_token_scale=per_token_scale,
+                num_experts=self.global_num_experts,
+                top_k=topk_ids.shape[1],
+                n_group=0,
+                topk_group=0,
+                intermediate_size=self.intermediate_size_per_partition,
+                local_expert_offset=self.local_expert_offset,
+                local_num_experts=self.num_local_experts,
+                # Muse folds its route_scale into the top-k weights, so the
+                # kernel applies none of its own -- but it wants 1.0, not None.
+                routed_scaling_factor=1.0,
+                routing_method_type=1,  # unused on this path, must be 1
+                do_finalize=False,  # we need the per-expert outputs
+                activation_type=3,  # SwiGLU
+            )[:3]
+        )
+
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.flashinfer_trtllm import (
+            FlashInferTrtllmDeferredFinalizeOutput,
+        )
+
+        return self._finalize_deferred_output(
+            FlashInferTrtllmDeferredFinalizeOutput(
+                gemm2_out=gemm2_out,
+                expert_weights=expert_weights,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx,
+                top_k=topk_ids.shape[1],
+            ),
+            num_tokens=num_tokens,
+            post_expert_norm=post_expert_norm,
+            out_dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
+            ar_workspace=ar_workspace,
+        )
+
+
+def finalize_with_post_expert_norm(
+    *,
+    gemm2_out: torch.Tensor,
+    expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx: torch.Tensor,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    top_k: int,
+    post_expert_norm: Optional[nn.Module],
+    out_dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Unpermute, apply the per-expert norm, then the top-k weighted sum.
+
+    ``expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx`` maps each (token, slot) pair to its row in
+    the permuted ``gemm2_out``; ``-1`` marks a padded or non-local slot, which
+    must contribute nothing.
+    """
+    flat_map = expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.reshape(-1)
+    valid = flat_map >= 0
+
+    gathered = gemm2_out.new_zeros((flat_map.numel(), hidden_size))
+    if valid.any():
+        gathered[valid] = gemm2_out[flat_map[valid]].to(gathered.dtype)
+
+    # Norm is per expert output, i.e. before the weighted sum -- not after.
+    if post_expert_norm is not None:
+        gathered = post_expert_norm(gathered)
+
+    gathered = gathered.view(num_tokens, top_k, hidden_size)
+    weights = expert_weights.reshape(num_tokens, top_k).to(gathered.dtype)
+    weights = weights * valid.view(num_tokens, top_k).to(gathered.dtype)
+    return torch.einsum("tkh,tk->th", gathered, weights).to(out_dtype)
+
+
+def finalize_identity_with_post_expert_norm(
+    *,
+    expert_outputs: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_scores: torch.Tensor,
+    post_expert_norm: nn.Module,
+    out_dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    num_tokens, top_k = expert_outputs.shape[0], expert_outputs.shape[1]
+    normed = post_expert_norm(expert_outputs)
+    weights = topk_scores.reshape(num_tokens, top_k).to(normed.dtype)
+    return (normed * weights.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1).to(out_dtype)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MuseSpark1xFp4Experts",
+    "finalize_with_post_expert_norm",
+    "finalize_identity_with_post_expert_norm",
+]

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed import moe_tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton import FusedMoE
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.token_dispatcher.standard import StandardDispatchOutput
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import StandardTopKOutput
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xInt4Experts(FusedMoE):
+    """Routed experts using AutoGPTQ INT4 or per-layer BF16 weights.
+
+    The dense equivalents of the packed weights are ``w13 [2*I, H]`` and
+    ``w2 [H, I]``.
+
+    With ``moe_tp_size > 1`` the intermediate dim is sharded instead of the
+    expert set: every rank holds every expert but only ``I / tp`` of each one,
+    so each rank does an equal share of the work no matter how the router
+    spreads a batch. See ``forward`` for the reduction that costs.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        num_experts: int,
+        expert_hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size: int,
+        top_k: int,
+        layer_id: int,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            num_experts=num_experts,
+            hidden_size=expert_hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=intermediate_size,
+            layer_id=layer_id,
+            top_k=top_k,
+            params_dtype=torch.get_default_dtype(),
+            reduce_results=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            activation="silu",
+            inplace=False,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.gptq.gptq import GPTQMoEMethod
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.gptq.schemes.gptq_cpu import (
+            GPTQIntelAMXMoEScheme,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.unquant import UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod
+
+        if not (
+            isinstance(self.quant_method, UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod)
+            or (
+                isinstance(self.quant_method, GPTQMoEMethod)
+                and isinstance(self.scheme, GPTQIntelAMXMoEScheme)
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Muse Spark experts require GPTQ INT4 or BF16 MoE, got "
+                f"quant_method={type(self.quant_method).__name__}, "
+                f"scheme={type(self.scheme).__name__}"
+            )
+        self.local_expert_offset = self.moe_ep_rank * self.num_local_experts
+        self.expert_hidden_size = expert_hidden_size
+        self.intermediate_size = intermediate_size
+        self.nvfp4_dynamic_per_token = False
+
+    def _fused_experts(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        local_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """One grouped MoE call over the flattened (token, slot) pairs.
+
+        ``fused_experts_cpu`` folds the top-k weighted sum into its epilogue,
+        which would put the reduction before Muse's post-expert norm. Passing
+        topk=1 with unit weights makes that epilogue an identity, so this
+        returns the per-(token, expert) outputs the norm needs -- the CPU
+        equivalent of the FP4 path's ``do_finalize=False``.
+        """
+        rows = token_ids.numel()
+        x = hidden_states.index_select(0, token_ids).contiguous()
+        ids = local_ids.to(torch.int32).view(rows, 1)
+        weights = torch.ones((rows, 1), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+        dispatch_output = StandardDispatchOutput(
+            hidden_states=x,
+            hidden_states_scale=None,
+            topk_output=StandardTopKOutput(weights, ids, None),
+        )
+        return self.run_moe_core(dispatch_output).hidden_states
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_scores: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        post_expert_norm: nn.Module | None = None,
+        *,
+        packed_topk_ids=None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if kwargs.get("pre_quantized") is not None:
+            raise ValueError("CPU experts do not accept pre-quantized input")
+        output = torch.zeros_like(hidden_states)
+        # Padded rows carry topk_id -1, which falls outside this rank's experts.
+        local_ids = topk_ids - self.local_expert_offset
+        routed = ((local_ids >= 0) & (local_ids < self.num_local_experts)).nonzero(
+            as_tuple=False
+        )
+        if routed.numel() == 0:
+            return output
+        token_ids = routed[:, 0]
+        slots = routed[:, 1]
+        local_ids = local_ids[token_ids, slots]
+
+        expert_output = self._fused_experts(hidden_states, token_ids, local_ids)
+        if self.moe_tp_size > 1:
+            # Each rank holds a slice of the intermediate dim, so expert_output
+            # is a partial sum. The post-expert norm is per-(token, expert) and
+            # nonlinear, so the reduction has to happen here rather than on the
+            # block's output: one [rows, H] all-reduce instead of one [T, H].
+            # Every rank then holds the complete result, so the caller must not
+            # all-reduce again.
+            expert_output = moe_tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(expert_output)
+        if post_expert_norm is not None:
+            expert_output = post_expert_norm(expert_output)
+        expert_output = expert_output * topk_scores[token_ids, slots].unsqueeze(-1)
+        output.index_add_(0, token_ids, expert_output.to(output.dtype))
+        return output
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MuseSpark1xInt4Experts",
+]

+"""Small, torch-native layer primitives used by the Muse Spark model."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import enum
+import math
+from typing import Optional, Tuple, Union
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed import divide
+from sglang.srt.distributed.utils import get_group_rank_size
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    LinearParallelGroup,
+    resolve_linear_parallel_group,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_cpu
+
+_is_cpu = is_cpu()
+
+
+class GainCenterType(enum.Enum):
+    ONE = "one"
+    ZERO = "zero"
+    INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX = "inverse_residual_index"
+    INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX_V2 = "inverse_residual_index_v2"
+    INVERSE_SQRT_RESIDUAL_INDEX = "inverse_sqrt_residual_index"
+    INVERSE_SQRT_LAYERS = "inverse_sqrt_layers"
+
+
+def calculate_gain_center(
+    gain_center_type: str, residual_id: int, n_layers: Optional[int] = None
+) -> float:
+    gain_center = GainCenterType(gain_center_type)
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.ONE:
+        return 1.0
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.ZERO:
+        return 0.0
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX:
+        return 1.0 / (2.0 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2.0))
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_RESIDUAL_INDEX_V2:
+        return 1.0 / (residual_id + 1.0)
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_SQRT_RESIDUAL_INDEX:
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2.0))
+    if gain_center == GainCenterType.INVERSE_SQRT_LAYERS:
+        if n_layers is None:
+            raise ValueError("n_layers is required for inverse_sqrt_layers")
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(n_layers)
+    raise ValueError(f"Unknown gain_center_type: {gain_center_type}")
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        eps: float = 1e-6,
+        has_weight: bool = True,
+        is_post_norm: bool = False,
+        zero_centered_gamma: bool = False,
+        post_norm_gain_center_type: str = "one",
+        output_norm_gain_center_type: str = "zero",
+        residual_id: Optional[int] = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.has_weight = has_weight
+        self.zero_centered_gamma = zero_centered_gamma
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(hidden_size)) if has_weight else None
+        # object.__setattr__ so this inference-only cache never registers as a
+        # second Parameter; filled by precompute_effective_weight() after load.
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_frozen_weight", None)
+        self.gain_center = 1.0
+        if residual_id is not None and is_post_norm:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                post_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+        elif residual_id == -1:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                output_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+
+    def _get_effective_weight(self) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        if self.weight is None or not self.zero_centered_gamma:
+            return self.weight
+        if self._frozen_weight is not None:
+            return self._frozen_weight
+        return self.weight + self.gain_center
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def precompute_effective_weight(self) -> None:
+        if self.weight is not None and self.zero_centered_gamma:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "_frozen_weight", (self.weight + self.gain_center).detach()
+            )
+

+"""Optional Muse Spark MegaMoE adapter for sequence-sharded BF16 prefill.
+
+The caller selects active layernorm SP. Decode continues to use the canonical
+TRTLLM parameters. DeepGEMM's ``weight_layout="trtllm"`` reads the same
+final weight and scale storage directly. Both kernels apply Muse's
+per-expert norm before the route-weighted sum, using DeepGEMM.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+
+import torch
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_MEGAMOE_SYMM_BUFFERS: dict = {}
+
+
+def _dimensions(layer):
+    if hasattr(layer, "global_num_experts"):
+        return (
+            layer.global_num_experts,
+            layer.hidden_size,
+            layer.intermediate_size_per_partition,
+        )
+    return layer.num_experts, layer.expert_hidden_size, layer.intermediate_size
+
+
+def _gemm_shapes(hidden, intermediate):
+    """(mn, k) for L1 and L2."""
+    return (2 * intermediate, hidden), (hidden, intermediate)
+
+
+def _check_canonical_weights(layer, mma_type):
+    experts, hidden, intermediate = _dimensions(layer)
+    local = layer.num_local_experts
+    packed = 2 if mma_type == "nvfp4xnvfp4" else 1
+    (mn1, k1), (mn2, k2) = _gemm_shapes(hidden, intermediate)
+    if (
+        tuple(layer.gate_up_proj.shape) != (local, mn1, k1 // packed)
+        or tuple(layer.down_proj.shape) != (local, mn2, k2 // packed)
+        or local <= 0
+        or experts % local
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Muse MegaMoE requires canonical local expert weight shapes.")
+    if getattr(layer, "load_up_proj_weight_first", False):
+        raise ValueError("Muse MegaMoE requires canonical [gate; up] weight order.")
+    if getattr(layer, "gemm1_clamp_limit", None) is not None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Muse MegaMoE does not support this checkpoint's SwiGLU clamp."
+        )
+
+
+def _same_weight_storage(view, parameter):
+    return (
+        view.is_contiguous()
+        and parameter.is_contiguous()
+        and view.untyped_storage().data_ptr() == parameter.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+        and view.data_ptr() == parameter.data_ptr()
+        and view.numel() * view.element_size()
+        == parameter.numel() * parameter.element_size()
+    )
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def bind_megamoe_shared_weights(layer, mma_type) -> None:
+    """Bind exact final TRT-LLM byte ranges; views never repack weights.
+
+    Run after TRT-LLM's final row shuffle (and BF16 BlockMajorK conversion).
+    The logical 3D view describes dimensions only; the kernel knows the physical
+    TRT layout. Repeated preparation verifies that no weight was replaced.
+    """
+    if not getattr(layer, "_megamoe_metadata_prepared", False):
+        raise RuntimeError("Prepare Muse MegaMoE metadata before TRT alignment.")
+    _, hidden, intermediate = _dimensions(layer)
+    local = layer.num_local_experts
+    if mma_type not in ("nvfp4xnvfp4", "bf16xbf16"):
+        raise ValueError("Unsupported Muse MegaMoE weight type.")
+    packed = 2 if mma_type == "nvfp4xnvfp4" else 1
+    (mn1, k1), (mn2, k2) = _gemm_shapes(hidden, intermediate)
+    if getattr(layer, "_megamoe_weights_built", False):
+        l1, l2 = layer.megamoe_l1_weights, layer.megamoe_l2_weights
+        if isinstance(l1, tuple):
+            l1, l2 = l1[0], l2[0]
+    else:
+        l1, l2 = layer.gate_up_proj.detach(), layer.down_proj.detach()
+        if packed == 2:
+            l1, l2 = l1.view(torch.int8), l2.view(torch.int8)
+        l1 = l1.view(local, mn1, k1 // packed)
+        l2 = l2.view(local, mn2, k2 // packed)
+    if not all(
+        _same_weight_storage(view, parameter)
+        for view, parameter in ((l1, layer.gate_up_proj), (l2, layer.down_proj))
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("Muse MegaMoE must alias the final TRT-LLM weights.")
+    extra = []
+    if packed == 2:
+        # TRT-LLM's own scale tensors, one UE4M3 word per 64 elements of k: its
+        # tensor maps carry TRT's axis order, so nothing is copied or permuted,
+        # and a padded one fails the view.
+        sf1 = (
+            layer.gate_up_proj_weight_scale.detach()
+            .reshape(local, -1)
+            .view(torch.int32)
+        )
+        sf2 = layer.down_proj_weight_scale.detach().reshape(local, -1).view(torch.int32)
+        l1 = (l1, sf1.view(local, mn1, k1 // 64))
+        l2 = (l2, sf2.view(local, mn2, k2 // 64))
+        extra = [
+            layer.megamoe_l1_alphas,
+            layer.megamoe_l2_alphas,
+            layer.megamoe_l2_act_scales,
+        ]
+    layer.megamoe_l1_weights, layer.megamoe_l2_weights = l1, l2
+    layer._megamoe_mma_type = mma_type
+    allocations = {
+        t.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): t.untyped_storage().nbytes()
+        for t in extra
+        if t is not None
+    }
+    layer.megamoe_weight_bytes = sum(allocations.values())
+    layer._megamoe_weights_built = True
+    logger.debug(
+        "Muse %s MegaMoE shares TRT weights; extra metadata %.3f GiB",
+        mma_type,
+        layer.megamoe_weight_bytes / (1 << 30),
+    )
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def build_nvfp4_megamoe_weights(layer) -> None:
+    """Capture accumulator alphas before TRT-LLM alignment rewrites their source.
+
+    Scales are not captured: `bind_megamoe_shared_weights` reads TRT-LLM's own.
+    Dequant alphas stay on their own accumulator, since folding small GEMM1
+    alphas into FP8 block scales can flush values to zero.
+    """
+    if getattr(layer, "_megamoe_metadata_prepared", False):
+        return
+
+    mma_type = "nvfp4xnvfp4"
+    _check_canonical_weights(layer, mma_type)
+    w13, w2 = layer.gate_up_proj.detach(), layer.down_proj.detach()
+    sf13, sf2 = (
+        layer.gate_up_proj_weight_scale.detach(),
+        layer.down_proj_weight_scale.detach(),
+    )
+    if (
+        w13.dtype not in (torch.uint8, torch.int8)
+        or w2.dtype not in (torch.uint8, torch.int8)
+        or sf13.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or sf2.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Muse MegaMoE expects packed NVFP4 and E4M3 block scales.")
+    local = layer.num_local_experts
+    s13 = layer.gate_up_proj_weight_scale_2.detach().float()
+    if s13.ndim == 1:
+        s13 = s13[:, None].expand(-1, 2)
+    if s13.shape != (local, 2):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Muse MegaMoE requires one gate/up alpha pair per local expert."
+        )
+    s13 = s13.clone().contiguous()
+    s2 = layer.down_proj_weight_scale_2.detach().float().flatten().clone()

+    # neutralize the latter when per-token activation quantization is enabled.
+    in2_inv = layer.down_proj_input_scale.detach().float().flatten()
+    global_experts, _, _ = _dimensions(layer)
+    if in2_inv.numel() == global_experts and global_experts != local:
+        offset = layer.local_expert_offset
+        in2_inv = in2_inv[offset : offset + local]
+    if s2.numel() != local or in2_inv.numel() != local:
+        raise ValueError("Muse MegaMoE requires one GEMM2 scale per local expert.")
+    act_scales = torch.where(in2_inv > 0, in2_inv.reciprocal(), 1.0)
+    if bool(torch.all(act_scales == 1)):
+        act_scales = None

+        act_scales = act_scales.contiguous()
+        s2 = s2 / act_scales
+
+    layer.megamoe_l1_alphas = s13
+    layer.megamoe_l2_alphas = s2.contiguous()
+    layer.megamoe_l2_act_scales = act_scales
+    layer._megamoe_metadata_prepared = True
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def build_bf16_megamoe_weights(layer) -> None:
+    """Validate canonical BF16 experts before TRT-LLM shuffles them in place."""
+    if getattr(layer, "_megamoe_metadata_prepared", False):
+        return

+        raise ValueError("Muse BF16 MegaMoE requires BF16 checkpoint expert weights.")

+
+
+def _is_capturing():
+    return torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+
+
+def _is_weight_first(norm):
+    if norm is None:

+        MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale,

+@torch.no_grad()

+        post_expert_norm,
+        weight,

+

+def _get_ep_group():

+def pad_navit_for_unaligned_cpu_tp(
+    config: MuseSparkVisionConfig, tp_size: int
+) -> MuseSparkVisionConfig:
+    """Pad NaViT dimensions for unaligned CPU tensor parallelism.
+
+    VisionAttention sizes its projections for ``num_dummy_heads + num_heads`` and
+    shards that, so head_dim stays derived from the real head count.
+    """
+    from sglang.srt.configs.update_config import DEFAULT_MOE_PADDING_SIZE
+    from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import pad_vocab_size
+
+    heads = config.num_attention_heads
+    config.num_dummy_heads = (
+        0 if heads % tp_size == 0 else (heads // tp_size + 1) * tp_size - heads
+    )
+    # The MLP is column/row parallel, so widen it too. CPU linear loaders narrow
+    # padded parameters against the unpadded checkpoint tensors and zero-fill
+    # the padded tails.
+    block = tp_size * DEFAULT_MOE_PADDING_SIZE
+    if config.intermediate_size % tp_size:
+        config.intermediate_size = pad_vocab_size(config.intermediate_size, block)
+    return config

+def _rope_frequencies(
+    head_dim: int,
+    grid_h: int,
+    grid_w: int,
+    theta: float,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if head_dim % 4:
+        raise ValueError("NaViT attention head size must be divisible by four")
+    half_dim = head_dim // 2
+    exponents = torch.arange(0, half_dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    inverse = theta ** (-exponents / half_dim)
+    pos_h = torch.arange(1, grid_h + 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    pos_w = torch.arange(1, grid_w + 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    mesh_h, mesh_w = torch.meshgrid(pos_h, pos_w, indexing="ij")
+    freq_h = torch.einsum("hw,d->hwd", mesh_h, inverse)
+    freq_w = torch.einsum("hw,d->hwd", mesh_w, inverse)
+    angles = torch.cat((freq_w, freq_h), dim=-1)
+    return torch.stack((angles.cos(), angles.sin()), dim=-1)
+

+def _patch_grid_positions(
+    grid_h: int,
+    grid_w: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return fp32 grid-sample coordinates for the checkpoint's xy (non-ij) layout."""
+    pos_h = torch.linspace(
+        -1 + 1 / grid_h,
+        1 - 1 / grid_h,
+        grid_h,
+        device=device,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+    )
+    pos_w = torch.linspace(
+        -1 + 1 / grid_w,
+        1 - 1 / grid_w,
+        grid_w,
+        device=device,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+    )
+    return torch.stack(torch.meshgrid(pos_h, pos_w, indexing="xy"), dim=-1).reshape(
+        -1, 2
+    )
+

+def _apply_rope(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key: torch.Tensor,
+    frequencies: torch.Tensor,
+    x_shape=None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    cosine = frequencies[..., 0].unsqueeze(1)
+    sine = frequencies[..., 1].unsqueeze(1)
+
+    def rotate(value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        pairs = value.float().reshape(*value.shape[:-1], -1, 2)
+        first, second = pairs.unbind(dim=-1)
+        rotated = torch.stack(
+            (first * cosine - second * sine, first * sine + second * cosine),
+            dim=-1,
+        ).flatten(-2)
+        return rotated.to(value.dtype)
+
+    return rotate(query), rotate(key)
+

+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=64)

+def _pixel_shuffle_permutation(
+    offset: int, grid_h: int, grid_w: int, factor: int, device: torch.device
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
+    if grid_h % factor or grid_w % factor:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "preprocessed image grid is not divisible by downsample factor"
+        )
+    order = torch.arange(offset, offset + grid_h * grid_w, device=device)
+    order = (
+        order.reshape(grid_h // factor, factor, grid_w // factor, factor)
+        .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+        .reshape(-1)
+    )
+    return order, offset + grid_h * grid_w
+

+def _sparse_permutation(
+    offset: int,
+    grid_h: int,
+    grid_w: int,
+    block_h: int,
+    block_w: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, list[int], int]:
+    padded_h = math.ceil(grid_h / block_h) * block_h
+    padded_w = math.ceil(grid_w / block_w) * block_w
+    order = torch.arange(offset, offset + grid_h * grid_w, device=device).reshape(
+        grid_h, grid_w
+    )
+    order = F.pad(order, (0, padded_w - grid_w, 0, padded_h - grid_h), value=-1)
+    rows, cols = padded_h // block_h, padded_w // block_w
+    order = (
+        order.reshape(rows, block_h, cols, block_w)
+        .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+        .reshape(rows * cols, block_h * block_w)
+    )
+    lengths = (order != -1).sum(dim=1).tolist()
+    order = order[order != -1]
+    return order, lengths, offset + grid_h * grid_w
+
+
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=64)
+def _cached_pixel_shuffle_permutation(
+    grid_h: int, grid_w: int, factor: int, device: torch.device
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    order, _ = _pixel_shuffle_permutation(0, grid_h, grid_w, factor, device)
+    return order
+
+
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=64)
+def _cached_sparse_permutation(
+    grid_h: int,
+    grid_w: int,
+    block_h: int,
+    block_w: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, tuple[int, ...]]:
+    order, lengths, _ = _sparse_permutation(0, grid_h, grid_w, block_h, block_w, device)
+    return order, tuple(lengths)
+
+
+def _build_vision_attention_metadata(
+    sequence_lengths: Sequence[int], device: torch.device
+) -> VisionAttentionMetadata:
+    cu_seqlens = torch.zeros(len(sequence_lengths) + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    if sequence_lengths:
+        cu_seqlens[1:] = torch.tensor(sequence_lengths, dtype=torch.int32).cumsum(0)
+    return prepare_vision_attention_metadata(
+        cu_seqlens,

+    )

+class NaViTMLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size: int,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        use_data_parallel: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if use_data_parallel:
+            self.fc1 = ReplicatedLinear(
+                hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size,
+                bias=True,
+                prefix=add_prefix("fc1", prefix),
+            )
+            self.fc2 = ReplicatedLinear(
+                intermediate_size,
+                hidden_size,
+                bias=True,
+                prefix=add_prefix("fc2", prefix),
+            )
+        else:
+            self.fc1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                input_size=hidden_size,
+                output_size=intermediate_size,
+                bias=True,
+                prefix=add_prefix("fc1", prefix),
+            )
+            self.fc2 = RowParallelLinear(
+                input_size=intermediate_size,
+                output_size=hidden_size,
+                bias=True,
+                prefix=add_prefix("fc2", prefix),
+            )
+
+    def forward(self, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        value, _ = self.fc1(value)
+        value, _ = self.fc2(F.gelu(value))
+        return value
+

+class NaViTBlock(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(

+        intermediate_size: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        use_rope: bool,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        use_data_parallel: bool = False,
+        num_dummy_heads: int = 0,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-5,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if hidden_size % num_heads:
+            raise ValueError("vision hidden size must be divisible by attention heads")
+        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.attn = VisionAttention(
+            embed_dim=hidden_size,
+            num_heads=num_heads,
+            num_dummy_heads=num_dummy_heads,
+            head_dim=hidden_size // num_heads,
+            projection_size=hidden_size,
+            use_qkv_parallel=True,
+            qkv_bias=True,
+            proj_bias=True,
+            softmax_scale=(hidden_size // num_heads) ** -0.5,
+            flatten_batch=True,
+            customized_position_embedding_applier=(_apply_rope if use_rope else None),
+            use_data_parallel=use_data_parallel,
+            prefix=add_prefix("attn", prefix),
+        )
+        self.use_rope = use_rope
+        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.mlp = NaViTMLP(
+            hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size,
+            add_prefix("mlp", prefix),
+            use_data_parallel=use_data_parallel,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        frequencies: torch.Tensor,
+        metadata: VisionAttentionMetadata,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        attn_output = self.attn(
+            self.norm1(value),
+            cu_seqlens=metadata.cu_seqlens,
+            position_embeddings=frequencies if self.use_rope else None,
+            forward_metadata=metadata,
+            max_seqlen=metadata.max_seqlen,
+        )

+        return value + self.mlp(self.norm2(value))

+            config.layer_types

+            raise ValueError("Invalid Muse vision layer_types")
+        latent_size = config.hidden_size

+        self.pos_grid_h = config.pos_emb_height
+        self.pos_grid_w = config.pos_emb_width

+            3 * config.patch_size * config.patch_size * config.patch_temporal

+                patch_input_size,

+                bias=False,

+            )

+                input_size=patch_input_size,
+                output_size=latent_size,
+                bias=False,
+                gather_output=True,
+                prefix=add_prefix("patch_embedder.patch_embedding", prefix),
+            )

+            position_count, latent_size

+            self.patch_embedder.position_embedding_table.weight, std=latent_size**-0.5

+            NaViTBlock(
+                config.hidden_size,
+                config.intermediate_size,
+                config.num_attention_heads,
+                True,
+                add_prefix(f"layers.{i}", prefix),
+                use_data_parallel=use_data_parallel,
+                num_dummy_heads=getattr(config, "num_dummy_heads", 0),

+            position_weights.float()

+            .unsqueeze(0)

+            position_grid,
+            positions[None, None],

+
+        full_metadata = _build_vision_attention_metadata(full_sequence_lengths, device)
+        if self.has_window_attention:
+            sparse_order = torch.cat(sparse_orders)

+def get_navit_patch_count(
+    img_h: int,
+    img_w: int,
+    patch_h: int,
+    patch_w: int,
+    downsample_factor: int,
+) -> int:
+    return (img_h // patch_h) * (img_w // patch_w) // (downsample_factor**2)
+
+
+def get_navit_video_patch_count(
+    video_t: int,
+    video_h: int,
+    video_w: int,
+    patch_t: int,
+    patch_h: int,
+    patch_w: int,
+    downsample_factor: int,
+) -> int:
+    return (video_t // patch_t) * get_navit_patch_count(
+        video_h, video_w, patch_h, patch_w, downsample_factor
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "NaViT",
+    "get_navit_patch_count",
+    "get_navit_video_patch_count",

+def _align_fp4_moe_weights_for_flashinfer_trtllm(layer) -> None:
+    """Align Muse's ``[w1, w3]`` checkpoint layout in-place.
+
+    The kernel permutation interleaves gated rows but does not exchange the
+    checkpoint's logical gate/up halves. Muse therefore performs the explicit
+    ``[w1, w3] -> [w3, w1]`` reorder before the standard shuffle. The aligned
+    tensors replace the canonical parameters so the model keeps only one copy.
+    """
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.utils import (
+        prepare_static_weights_for_trtllm_fp4_moe,
+        reorder_w1w3_to_w3w1,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.layers.utils import copy_or_rebind_param
+
+    w13_weight = cast(torch.Tensor, layer.gate_up_proj)
+    w2_weight = cast(torch.Tensor, layer.down_proj)
+    w13_weight_scale = cast(torch.Tensor, layer.gate_up_proj_weight_scale)
+    w2_weight_scale = cast(torch.Tensor, layer.down_proj_weight_scale)
+
+    if layer.moe_runner_config.is_gated:
+        w13_weight, w13_weight_scale = reorder_w1w3_to_w3w1(
+            w13_weight, w13_weight_scale
+        )
+
+    (
+        gemm1_weights_fp4_shuffled,
+        gemm1_scales_fp4_shuffled,
+        gemm2_weights_fp4_shuffled,
+        gemm2_scales_fp4_shuffled,
+    ) = prepare_static_weights_for_trtllm_fp4_moe(
+        w13_weight,
+        w2_weight,
+        w13_weight_scale,
+        w2_weight_scale,
+        w2_weight.size(-2),
+        w13_weight.size(-2) // 2,
+        w13_weight.size(0),
+        is_gated=layer.moe_runner_config.is_gated,
+    )
+
+    copy_or_rebind_param(layer, "gate_up_proj", gemm1_weights_fp4_shuffled.contiguous())
+    copy_or_rebind_param(layer, "down_proj", gemm2_weights_fp4_shuffled.contiguous())
+    copy_or_rebind_param(
+        layer, "gate_up_proj_weight_scale", gemm1_scales_fp4_shuffled.contiguous()
+    )
+    copy_or_rebind_param(
+        layer, "down_proj_weight_scale", gemm2_scales_fp4_shuffled.contiguous()
+    )
+
+    # The up-projection (w3), not the gate (w1), supplies TRT-LLM's extra
+    # GEMM1-output dequantization factor before GEMM2 requantization.
+    w2_input_scale_quant = cast(torch.Tensor, layer.w2_input_scale_quant)
+    w13_weight_scale_2 = cast(torch.Tensor, layer.gate_up_proj_weight_scale_2)
+    if (
+        layer.moe_runner_config.is_gated
+        and w13_weight_scale_2.dim() == 2
+        and w13_weight_scale_2.shape[1] >= 2
+    ):
+        w13_input_scale = (1.0 / layer.w13_input_scale_quant).to(torch.float32)
+        g1_scale_c = (
+            w13_input_scale * w13_weight_scale_2[:, 1] * w2_input_scale_quant
+        ).to(torch.float32)
+    else:
+        g1_alphas = cast(torch.Tensor, layer.g1_alphas)
+        g1_scale_c = (w2_input_scale_quant * g1_alphas).to(torch.float32)
+    copy_or_rebind_param(layer, "g1_scale_c", g1_scale_c.contiguous())

+class MuseSparkNvFp4FusedMoEMethod(ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod):
+    """Prepare Muse FP4 experts without process-global mutation or duplication."""
+
+    def create_weights(

+        num_experts,
+        hidden_size,
+        intermediate_size_per_partition,
+        params_dtype,
+        **extra_weight_attrs,
+    ):
+        """Allocate the serialized HF expert tensors without renaming them."""
+        n, h, i = num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size_per_partition
+        group = self.quant_config.group_size
+        for name, shape, dtype in (
+            ("gate_up_proj", (n, 2 * i, h // 2), torch.uint8),
+            ("down_proj", (n, h, i // 2), torch.uint8),
+            ("gate_up_proj_weight_scale", (n, 2 * i, h // group), torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+            ("down_proj_weight_scale", (n, h, i // group), torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+            ("gate_up_proj_weight_scale_2", (n, 2), torch.float32),
+            ("down_proj_weight_scale_2", (n,), torch.float32),
+            ("gate_up_proj_input_scale", (n, 2), torch.float32),
+            ("down_proj_input_scale", (n,), torch.float32),
+        ):

+                name,
+                torch.nn.Parameter(
+                    torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype), requires_grad=False

+            )

+    # The base method's Marlin branch, and prepare_moe_nvfp4_layer_for_marlin
+    # underneath it, address the experts by their pre-rename names.
+    _MARLIN_PARAM_ALIASES = (
+        ("w13_weight", "gate_up_proj"),
+        ("w2_weight", "down_proj"),
+        ("w13_weight_scale", "gate_up_proj_weight_scale"),
+        ("w2_weight_scale", "down_proj_weight_scale"),
+        ("w13_weight_scale_2", "gate_up_proj_weight_scale_2"),
+        ("w2_weight_scale_2", "down_proj_weight_scale_2"),
+    )
+
+    def _process_weights_for_marlin(self, layer):
+        for alias, native in self._MARLIN_PARAM_ALIASES:
+            setattr(layer, alias, getattr(layer, native))
+        result = super().process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+        # Marlin repacks into freshly allocated parameters. Drop the native
+        # names so the unpacked originals are freed instead of being kept
+        # alive at full size alongside the repacked copies.
+        for _, native in self._MARLIN_PARAM_ALIASES:
+            if native in layer._parameters:
+                del layer._parameters[native]
+            elif hasattr(layer, native):
+                delattr(layer, native)
+        return result
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer):
+        """Prepare the TRT-LLM layout from native HF parameters in place."""
+        backend = getattr(self, "_moe_runner_backend", None)
+        if backend is not None and backend.is_marlin():
+            return self._process_weights_for_marlin(layer)
+        input_scale = layer.gate_up_proj_input_scale.max().float()
+        output_scale = layer.down_proj_input_scale.max().float()
+        if self.quant_config.use_per_token_activation:
+            input_scale = torch.ones_like(input_scale)
+            output_scale = torch.ones_like(output_scale)
+        gate_alpha, up_alpha = _compute_gemm1_alphas(
+            layer.gate_up_proj_weight_scale_2, input_scale, True
+        )
+        copy_or_rebind_param(layer, "g1_alphas", gate_alpha)
+        copy_or_rebind_param(layer, "g1_alphas_up", up_alpha)
+        copy_or_rebind_param(
+            layer, "g2_alphas", output_scale * layer.down_proj_weight_scale_2
+        )
+        copy_or_rebind_param(layer, "w13_input_scale_quant", input_scale.reciprocal())
+        copy_or_rebind_param(layer, "w2_input_scale_quant", output_scale.reciprocal())
+        for weight, scale in (
+            (layer.gate_up_proj, layer.gate_up_proj_weight_scale),
+            (layer.down_proj, layer.down_proj_weight_scale),
+        ):
+            if (
+                scale.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+                or scale.shape[-1] != weight.shape[-1] * 2 // 16
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Muse NVFP4 requires one FP8 scale per 16 weight elements"
+                )
+        self._align_fp4_moe_weights_for_flashinfer_trtllm(layer)
+
+    def _align_fp4_moe_weights_for_flashinfer_trtllm(self, layer) -> None:
+        if getattr(layer, "use_megamoe", False):
+            from sglang.srt.layers.muse_spark.muse_spark_megamoe import (
+                build_nvfp4_megamoe_weights,
+            )
+
+            # Capture scale metadata while gate/up order is still canonical.
+            build_nvfp4_megamoe_weights(layer)
+        _align_fp4_moe_weights_for_flashinfer_trtllm(layer)
+        if getattr(layer, "use_megamoe", False):

+                bind_megamoe_shared_weights,
+            )
+
+            bind_megamoe_shared_weights(layer, "nvfp4xnvfp4")
+
