+                num_experts=self.num_experts,
+                expert_hidden_size=self.expert_hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=self.intermediate_size,
+                top_k=self.top_k,
+                layer_id=layer_idx,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=add_prefix("experts", prefix),
+            )
+        elif nvfp4_checkpoint:
+            # Packed NVFP4: the FlashInfer TRT-LLM kernel runs the experts and we
+            # finalize in torch so the post-expert norm lands before the top-k sum.
+            self.experts = MuseSpark1xFp4Experts(
+                num_experts=self.num_experts,
+                num_local_experts=self.num_local_experts,
+                local_expert_offset=self.local_expert_start,
+                hidden_size=self.expert_hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=self.intermediate_size,
+                top_k=self.top_k,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.experts = MuseSpark1xBf16Experts(
+                num_experts=self.num_experts,
+                num_local_experts=self.num_local_experts,
+                local_expert_offset=self.local_expert_start,
+                expert_hidden_size=self.expert_hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=self.intermediate_size,
+                top_k=self.top_k,
+            )
+        self.experts.post_expert_norm = post_expert_norm
+        self.experts.use_megamoe = self.use_megamoe
+        self.sp_dispatcher = None
+        self.finalize_ar_workspace = None
+        self.unpool_gather_boundary: Optional[FusedPostNormResidualPreNorm] = None
+        self.side_stream = None
+
+    def set_sp_dispatcher(self, dispatcher) -> None:
+        """Bind the model-scoped FlashInfer A2A workspace to this MoE layer."""
+        self.sp_dispatcher = dispatcher
+
+    def set_finalize_ar_workspace(self, workspace) -> None:
+        """Bind the model-scoped decode finalize/all-reduce workspace."""
+        self.finalize_ar_workspace = workspace
+
+    def set_unpool_gather_boundary(
+        self, boundary: FusedPostNormResidualPreNorm
+    ) -> None:
+        """Bind the FFN boundary that can absorb the unpooler all-gather."""
+        self.unpool_gather_boundary = boundary
+
+    def _side_stream(self) -> torch.cuda.Stream:
+        if self.side_stream is None:
+            self.side_stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        return self.side_stream
+
+    def _routing_op(self) -> FusedMuseSparkRouting:
+        """The fused router: sigmoid, biased top-k, gather, renormalise, scale.
+
+        Built lazily and rebound if ``expert_bias`` is replaced, because
+        ``Module._apply`` (``.to()``, ``.cuda()``) swaps the buffer for a new
+        tensor and the op holds a direct reference to it.
+        """
+        op = getattr(self, "_fused_routing_op", None)
+        if op is None or op.expert_bias is not self.gate.e_score_correction_bias:
+            op = FusedMuseSparkRouting(
+                expert_bias=self.gate.e_score_correction_bias,
+                route_scale=self.route_scale,
+                router_output_multiplier=self.router_multiplier,
+                router_score_division_eps=self.route_eps,
+            )
+            self._fused_routing_op = op
+        return op
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        router_input: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if (
+            forward_batch is not None
+            and is_dp_attention_enabled()
+            and get_parallel().attn_dp_size > 1
+        ):
+            return self._forward_dp_attention(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        return self._forward_tp(hidden_states, router_input, forward_batch)
+
+    def _forward_tp(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        router_input: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        ar_workspace = self.finalize_ar_workspace
+        # All TP ranks must select the same reduction owner.
+        if ar_workspace is not None and not (
+            forward_batch is not None
+            and (
+                forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+                or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            )
+            and self.moe_tp_size == 1
+            and not get_forward().sp_active
+            and hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and 0 < hidden_states.shape[0] <= ar_workspace.max_tokens
+            and ar_workspace.can_fuse(get_parallel().tp_group, hidden_states.shape[0])
+        ):
+            if (
+                forward_batch is not None
+                and (
+                    forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+                    or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+                )
+                and not ar_workspace.fallback_logged
+            ):
+                logger.warning(
+                    "Finalize AR fusion unavailable for this decode/verify batch "
+                    "(SP=%s, dtype=%s, tokens=%s, capacity=%s); "
+                    "requires non-SP BF16 decode/verify within capacity and custom "
+                    "AR with a compatible push workspace. Using separate finalize and AR.",
+                    get_forward().sp_active,
+                    hidden_states.dtype,
+                    hidden_states.shape[0],
+                    ar_workspace.max_tokens,
+                )
+                ar_workspace.fallback_logged = True
+            ar_workspace = None
+        output = self._forward_experts(
+            hidden_states,
+            router_input,
+            ar_workspace=ar_workspace,
+        )
+        return self._reduce_and_unpool(output, already_reduced=ar_workspace is not None)
+
+    def _reduce_and_unpool(
+        self, output: torch.Tensor, *, already_reduced: bool = False
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Expert TP already reduced across ranks, before its post-expert norm.
+        if (
+            self.tp_size > 1
+            and self.moe_tp_size == 1
+            and not getattr(get_forward(), "sp_active", False)
+            and not already_reduced
+        ):
+            output = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(output)
+        if self.post_expert_proj is not None:
+            if _is_cpu:
+                output, _ = self.post_expert_proj(output)
+                return output
+            comm = get_parallel().tp_group.ca_comm if self.tp_size > 1 else None
+            if not getattr(get_forward(), "sp_active", False) and gemm_ag_supported(
+                comm, output, self.post_expert_proj.weight
+            ):
+                # Returns this rank's [M, H / world] slice; the FFN boundary gathers it.
+                if self._defers_unpool_gather(comm, output.shape[0]):
+                    return gemm_local(comm, output, self.post_expert_proj.weight)
+                return gemm_ag(comm, output, self.post_expert_proj.weight)
+            output = bf16_gemm_dispatch(output, self.post_expert_proj.weight, None)
+        return output
+
+    def _defers_unpool_gather(self, comm, num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+        boundary = self.unpool_gather_boundary
+        return (
+            boundary is not None
+            and boundary.jit_selected()
+            and all_gather_norm_residual_supported(
+                comm=comm, num_tokens=num_tokens, hidden_size=self.hidden_size
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _forward_dp_attention(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Every rank runs the experts on the same DP-replicated global batch,
+        # so the full-TP all-reduce below stays correct.
+        tp_group = get_parallel().tp_group
+        global_hidden = get_global_dp_buffer(tp_group)
+        dp_gather_replicate(global_hidden, hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        output = self._forward_experts(global_hidden)
+        if self.tp_size > 1 and (not _is_cpu or self.moe_tp_size == 1):
+            output = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(output)
+        if self.post_expert_proj is not None:
+            if _is_cpu:
+                output, _ = self.post_expert_proj(output)
+            else:
+                output = self.post_expert_proj(output)
+        local_output = get_local_dp_buffer(tp_group)
+        dp_scatter(local_output, output, forward_batch)
+        return local_output
+
+    def _forward_experts(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        router_input: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        *,
+        ar_workspace=None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if hidden_states.shape[0] == 0:
+            return hidden_states.new_zeros((0, self.expert_hidden_size))
+        use_split2 = (
+            self.router_in_fp32
+            and _use_split_bf16_router(hidden_states.shape[0])
+            and self.gate.weight.dtype == torch.float32
+            and hidden_states.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+        )
+        if not use_split2 and router_input is None:
+            router_input = (
+                hidden_states.float() if self.router_in_fp32 else hidden_states
+            )
+        sp_active = getattr(get_forward(), "sp_active", False)
+        prepare_early = (
+            self.nvfp4_checkpoint
+            # Measured to help up to 128 tokens (decode c<=128); untested above.
+            and hidden_states.shape[0] <= 128
+            and not sp_active
+            and not getattr(self.experts, "use_marlin", False)
+        )
+        prepared_input = None
+        use_side_stream = not _is_cpu and torch.cuda.is_available()
+        main_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream() if use_side_stream else None
+        side_stream = self._side_stream() if use_side_stream else None
+        if use_side_stream:
+            side_stream.wait_stream(main_stream)
+        # nn.Linear bypasses the bf16 GEMM dispatcher.
+        if self.pre_expert_proj is None:
+            expert_input = hidden_states
+        elif _is_cpu:
+            expert_input, _ = self.pre_expert_proj(hidden_states)
+        else:
+            comm = get_parallel().tp_group.ca_comm if self.tp_size > 1 else None
+            if (
+                self.tp_size in (4, 8)
+                and not sp_active
+                and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(hidden_states.device) == (10, 3)
+                and gemm_ag_supported(comm, hidden_states, self.pre_expert_proj.weight)
+            ):
+                expert_input = gemm_ag(comm, hidden_states, self.pre_expert_proj.weight)
+            else:
+                expert_input = bf16_gemm_dispatch(
+                    hidden_states, self.pre_expert_proj.weight, None
+                )
+        if prepare_early:
+            prepared_input = self.experts.prepare_input(
+                expert_input, self.pre_expert_norm
+            )
+        with (
+            torch.cuda.stream(side_stream)
+            if use_side_stream
+            else contextlib.nullcontext()
+        ):
+            router_logits = (
+                self.gate.forward_split2(hidden_states)
+                if use_split2
+                else self.gate(router_input)
+            )
+            topk_scores, topk_ids, packed_topk_ids = self._routing_op()(
+                None, router_logits, self.top_k, True, want_packed=True
+            )
+        if use_side_stream:
+            main_stream.wait_stream(side_stream)
+        if use_side_stream and not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            cross_stream_tensors = (
+                (router_logits, topk_scores, topk_ids)
+                if getattr(get_forward(), "sp_active", False)
+                else (topk_scores, topk_ids, packed_topk_ids)
+            )
+            for tensor in cross_stream_tensors:
+                if tensor is not None:
+                    tensor.record_stream(main_stream)
+
+        if (capturer := get_global_experts_capturer()) is not None:
+            # Capture on main after the router join, in full unpadded token order.
+            # SP experts below still consume the local ids.
+            capture_topk_ids = topk_ids
+            if sp_active:
+                capture_topk_ids = layernorm_sp.sp_exit_gather(
+                    topk_ids, num_tokens=layernorm_sp.sp_num_tokens()
+                )
+            capturer.capture(layer_id=self.layer_idx, topk_indices=capture_topk_ids)
+        if getattr(get_forward(), "sp_active", False):
+            return self._forward_sp_experts(
+                expert_input, topk_scores, topk_ids, router_logits
+            )
+        if self.nvfp4_checkpoint:
+            output = self.experts(
+                expert_input,
+                topk_scores,
+                topk_ids,
+                self.experts.post_expert_norm,
+                pre_expert_norm=self.pre_expert_norm,
+                prepared_input=prepared_input,
+                packed_topk_ids=packed_topk_ids,
+                ar_workspace=ar_workspace,
+            )
+        else:
+            if self.pre_expert_norm is not None:
+                expert_input = self.pre_expert_norm(expert_input)
+            output = self.experts(
+                expert_input,
+                topk_scores,
+                topk_ids,
+                self.experts.post_expert_norm,
+                packed_topk_ids=packed_topk_ids,
+                ar_workspace=ar_workspace,
+            )
+        return output
+
+    def _forward_sp_experts(
+        self,
+        expert_input: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_scores: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Return combined source-token shards, before the nonlinear FFN tail."""
+        if self.pre_expert_norm is not None:
+            expert_input = self.pre_expert_norm(expert_input)
+        if self.use_megamoe:
+            from sglang.srt.layers.muse_spark.muse_spark_megamoe import forward_megamoe
+
+            return forward_megamoe(
+                self.experts,
+                expert_input,
+                topk_scores,
+                topk_ids,
+                self.experts.post_expert_norm,
+            )
+        if self.sp_dispatcher is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Muse Spark SP prefill requires an initialized FlashInfer A2A dispatcher."
+            )
+        dispatch_output = self.sp_dispatcher.dispatch(
+            expert_input, StandardTopKOutput(topk_scores, topk_ids, router_logits)
+        )
+        combine_input = self.experts.forward_dispatched(
+            dispatch_output, self.experts.post_expert_norm
+        )
+        return self.sp_dispatcher.combine(combine_input)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: MuseSparkTextConfig,
+        layer_idx: int,
+        nvfp4_checkpoint: bool,
+        prefix: str,
+        quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig] = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
+        self.operator_dtype = config.dtype
+        self.self_attn = MuseSpark1xAttention(
+            config, layer_idx, add_prefix("self_attn", prefix)
+        )
+        self.post_attn_norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.post_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=False,
+            is_post_norm=True,
+            zero_centered_gamma=True,
+            post_norm_gain_center_type="one",
+            residual_id=2 * layer_idx + 1,
+        )
+        self.pre_feedforward_layernorm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=True,
+            zero_centered_gamma=True,
+            residual_id=2 * layer_idx + 2,
+        )
+        ffn_norm_cls = MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale
+        self.post_feedforward_layernorm = ffn_norm_cls(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.post_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=True,
+            is_post_norm=True,
+            zero_centered_gamma=True,
+            post_norm_gain_center_type="one",
+            residual_id=2 * layer_idx + 2,
+        )
+        self.is_moe_layer = self._is_moe_layer(config, layer_idx)
+        self._router_dtype = torch.float32 if self.is_moe_layer else None
+        self.mlp = (
+            MuseSpark1xMoE(
+                config,
+                layer_idx,
+                nvfp4_checkpoint,
+                add_prefix("mlp", prefix),
+                quant_config,
+            )
+            if self.is_moe_layer
+            else MuseSpark1xMLP(config, add_prefix("mlp", prefix))
+        )
+        residual_cls = MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection
+        self.post_attention_residual_gate = residual_cls(
+            config.hidden_size, temperature=config.residual_gate_temperature
+        )
+        self.post_feedforward_residual_gate = residual_cls(
+            config.hidden_size, temperature=config.residual_gate_temperature
+        )
+        # Each boundary -- post-norm, residual add, next pre-norm -- is one fused
+        # kernel. The FFN boundary's pre-norm belongs to the next layer, so the
+        # model binds it in bind_next_pre_attn_norm once every layer exists.
+        self._fused_attn_boundary = FusedPostNormResidualPreNorm(
+            self.post_attn_norm,
+            self.post_attention_residual_gate,
+            self.pre_feedforward_layernorm,
+        )
+        self._fused_ffn_boundary = None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _is_moe_layer(config: MuseSparkTextConfig, layer_idx: int) -> bool:
+        return config.mlp_layer_types[layer_idx] == "sparse"
+
+    def bind_next_pre_attn_norm(self, next_pre_attn_norm: MuseSpark1xRMSNorm) -> None:
+        self._fused_ffn_boundary = FusedPostNormResidualPreNorm(
+            self.post_feedforward_layernorm,
+            self.post_feedforward_residual_gate,
+            next_pre_attn_norm,
+        )
+        if (
+            self.is_moe_layer
+            and self.operator_dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_MUSE_SPARK_AG_NORM_FUSION.get()
+        ):
+            self.mlp.set_unpool_gather_boundary(self._fused_ffn_boundary)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        stream: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_input: torch.Tensor,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]:
+        """Returns the updated residual stream and the next layer's attention input."""
+        attn_output = self.self_attn(positions, attn_input, forward_batch)
+        router_dtype = self._router_dtype
+        if router_dtype is not None and _use_split_bf16_router(attn_output.shape[0]):
+            router_dtype = None
+        ffn_input, stream, router_input = self._fused_attn_boundary(
+            stream,
+            attn_output,
+            branch_dtype=self.operator_dtype,
+            router_dtype=router_dtype,
+        )
+        if self.is_moe_layer:
+            ffn_output = self.mlp(ffn_input, router_input, forward_batch)
+        else:
+            ffn_output = self.mlp(ffn_input)
+        # A TP-sliced branch means the unpooler gather was deferred to the FFN boundary.
+        if ffn_output.shape[-1] != stream.shape[-1]:
+            next_attn_input, stream = self._fused_ffn_boundary.forward_with_ag(
+                stream, ffn_output, get_parallel().tp_group.ca_comm
+            )
+            return stream, next_attn_input
+        if self._fused_ffn_boundary is None:
+            return self.post_feedforward_residual_gate(
+                stream, self.post_feedforward_layernorm(ffn_output)
+            ), None
+        next_attn_input, stream, _ = self._fused_ffn_boundary(
+            stream, ffn_output, branch_dtype=self.operator_dtype
+        )
+        return stream, next_attn_input
+
+    def self_attn_input_norm(self, stream: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.input_layernorm(stream).to(self.operator_dtype)
+
+
+# Register the input norm at the decoder layer, as in the HF checkpoint.
+def _install_pre_attn_norm(
+    config: MuseSparkTextConfig, layer: MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer
+) -> None:
+    layer.input_layernorm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+        config.hidden_size,
+        eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+        has_weight=True,
+        zero_centered_gamma=True,
+        residual_id=2 * layer.layer_idx + 1,
+    )
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xModel(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: MuseSparkTextConfig,
+        quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig],
+        prefix: str,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = config
+        self.operator_dtype = config.dtype
+        self.residual_dtype = torch.float32
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=add_prefix("embed_tokens", prefix),
+            **get_embedding_tp_kwargs(),
+        )
+        self.embed_norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps, has_weight=False
+        )
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList()
+        # Safe to share: each MoE joins its side work before returning.
+        # torch.cuda.Stream() raises outright in a CPU-only build, so the CPU
+        # path never builds one; _forward_experts skips the overlap there.
+        side_stream = None if _is_cpu else torch.cuda.Stream()
+        for layer_idx in range(config.num_hidden_layers):
+            layer_prefix = add_prefix(f"layers.{layer_idx}", prefix)
+            layer = MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer(
+                config,
+                layer_idx,
+                _uses_nvfp4_experts(quant_config, layer_prefix),
+                layer_prefix,
+                quant_config,
+            )
+            if layer.is_moe_layer:
+                layer.mlp.side_stream = side_stream
+            _install_pre_attn_norm(config, layer)
+            self.layers.append(layer)
+        for layer, next_layer in zip(self.layers[:-1], self.layers[1:]):
+            layer.bind_next_pre_attn_norm(next_layer.input_layernorm)
+        self._sp_moe_dispatcher = None
+        self._finalize_ar_workspace = None
+        if is_cuda() and envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_MUSE_SPARK_FINALIZE_AR.get():
+            from sglang.kernels.ops.muse_spark.fi_trtllm_moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm_cutedsl import (
+                FinalizePushWorkspace,
+            )
+            from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce_v2 import (
+                CustomAllReduceV2,
+            )
+
+            tp_group = get_parallel().tp_group
+            if (
+                get_parallel().tp_size not in (4, 8)
+                or get_parallel().moe_ep_size != get_parallel().tp_size
+                or is_dp_attention_enabled()
+                or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 10
+            ):
+                logger.warning(
+                    "Finalize AR fusion unavailable: requires Blackwell TP4/EP4 or TP8/EP8 "
+                    "without DP attention. Using separate finalize and AR."
+                )
+            else:
+                moe_layers = [layer.mlp for layer in self.layers if layer.is_moe_layer]
+                comm = tp_group.ca_comm
+                if not moe_layers:
+                    logger.warning("Finalize AR fusion unavailable: no MoE layers")
+                elif not isinstance(comm, CustomAllReduceV2) or comm.disabled:
+                    logger.warning(
+                        "Finalize AR fusion unavailable: custom AR v2 is required. "
+                        "Using separate finalize and AR."
+                    )
+                elif (
+                    moe_layers[0].expert_hidden_size <= 0
+                    or moe_layers[0].expert_hidden_size % 256
+                    or comm.max_push_size < moe_layers[0].expert_hidden_size * 2
+                    or not 0
+                    < comm._push_counter.numel()
+                    <= torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+                        comm.device
+                    ).multi_processor_count
+                ):
+                    logger.warning(
+                        "Finalize AR fusion unavailable: unsupported hidden size "
+                        "or push workspace capacity. Using separate finalize and AR."
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self._finalize_ar_workspace = FinalizePushWorkspace(

+def _run_dp_sharded_encode(
+    features: list[torch.Tensor],
+    encode_cost_per_item: list[int],
+    tokens_per_item: list[int],
+    encode_fn,
+    out_hidden_size: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Mirrors run_dp_sharded_mrope_vision_model in sglang.srt.multimodal.mm_utils.
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    tp_size = parallel.attn_tp_size
+    tp_rank = parallel.attn_tp_rank
+    if tp_size == 1:
+        return encode_fn(features)
+
+    image_to_tp_rank, gpu_sample_counts, _ = get_dp_encoder_lb_assignment(
+        encode_cost_per_item, tp_size
+    )
+    cum_counts = [0, *itertools.accumulate(gpu_sample_counts)]
+    local_idxs = image_to_tp_rank[cum_counts[tp_rank] : cum_counts[tp_rank + 1]]
+
+    local_embeds = (
+        encode_fn([features[i] for i in local_idxs])
+        if local_idxs
+        else torch.empty((0, out_hidden_size), device=device, dtype=dtype)
+    )
+
+    # Single-item fast path: bit-identical to the all-gather below.
+    if len(features) == 1:
+        if tp_rank != 0:
+            local_embeds = torch.empty(
+                (tokens_per_item[0], out_hidden_size), device=device, dtype=dtype
+            )
+        get_parallel().attn_tp_group.broadcast(local_embeds, src=0)
+        return local_embeds
+
+    grouped_out_lengths = []
+    offset = 0
+    for count in gpu_sample_counts:
+        grouped_out_lengths.append(
+            sum(tokens_per_item[i] for i in image_to_tp_rank[offset : offset + count])
+        )
+        offset += count
+    max_len_per_rank = max(grouped_out_lengths)
+
+    padded = _pad_mrope_vision_embeddings_for_tp_gather(local_embeds, max_len_per_rank)
+    gathered = parallel.attn_tp_group.all_gather(padded, dim=0)
+
+    per_rank = []
+    for rank in range(tp_size):
+        start = rank * max_len_per_rank
+        per_rank.append(gathered[start : start + grouped_out_lengths[rank]])
+
+    ordered = [None] * len(features)
+    offset = 0
+    for rank in range(tp_size):
+        count = gpu_sample_counts[rank]
+        rank_images = image_to_tp_rank[offset : offset + count]
+        rank_embed = per_rank[rank]
+        embed_start = 0
+        for item_idx in rank_images:
+            n_tok = tokens_per_item[item_idx]
+            ordered[item_idx] = rank_embed[embed_start : embed_start + n_tok]
+            embed_start += n_tok
+        offset += count

+class _NormalizedEmbedding(nn.Module):

+        super().__init__()
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_embedding", embedding)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "_norm", norm)

+        return self._norm(self._embedding(input_ids))

+    def weight(self):
+        return self._embedding.weight

+        self.language_only = get_disagg().language_only
+        if self.encoder_only:

+            self.quant_config = quant_config
+            self.model = nn.Module()

+            # Preserve the exact norm without constructing the decoder or vocab.
+            self.model.language_model = nn.Module()

+                config.text_config.hidden_size,

+            ),

+            input_size=config.projector_hidden_size,
+            output_size=config.text_config.hidden_size,

+                    v.shape[0],

+                    v.shape[-1],

+                for v in videos
+            ]

+                costs,

+        waveforms = [
+            torch.as_tensor(item.feature).to(
+                device=parameter.device, dtype=parameter.dtype
+            )
+            for item in items
+        ]
+
+        def _encode_audio(local_waveforms):
+            output = torch.cat(self.model.audio_tower(local_waveforms), dim=0)
+            if self.model.language_model.embed_norm is not None:
+                output = self.model.language_model.embed_norm(output)
+            return output

+        if self.use_data_parallel_encoder:
+            patch = self.model.audio_tower.patch_size
+            costs = [w.numel() for w in waveforms]
+            tokens = [-(-w.numel() // patch) for w in waveforms]
+            return _run_dp_sharded_encode(
+                waveforms,
+                costs,
+                tokens,
+                _encode_audio,
+                self.config.hidden_size,
+                parameter.device,
+                parameter.dtype,
+            )

+
+    def pad_input_ids(
+        self, input_ids: list[int], mm_inputs: MultimodalInputs
+    ) -> list[int]:

+                    if not self.encoder_only:
+                        yield name, weight
+                    continue
+                if self.language_only and name.startswith(
+                    (
+                        "model.vision_tower.",
+                        "model.vision_adapter.",
+                        "model.vision_projection.",
+                        "model.audio_tower.",
+                    )
+                ):
+                    continue
+                if ".attn." in name:
+                    for projection in ("q", "k", "v"):
+                        marker = f".attn.{projection}_proj."
+                        if marker not in name:
+                            continue
+                        if projection in ("q", "k"):
+                            heads = self.model.vision_tower.config.num_attention_heads
+                            shape = weight.shape
+                            weight = (

+                                .transpose(1, 2)
+                                .reshape(shape)
+                                .contiguous()
+                            )

+                    else:
+                        parameter = parameters[name]
+                        getattr(parameter, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)(
+                            parameter, weight
+                        )
+                else:
+                    parameter = parameters[name]
+                    getattr(parameter, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)(
+                        parameter, weight
+                    )
+
+        if self.encoder_only:
+            # Iteration loads encoder tensors while filtering every decoder tensor.
+            for _ in text_weights():
+                pass
+        else:
+            super().load_weights(text_weights())
+

+"""GPU PIL-LANCZOS resampling with per-pass uint8 rounding.
+
+Coefficient geometry and 22-bit quantization follow the shared Rust/Pillow
+resampler. Keep the intermediate uint8 rounding; float bicubic is not equivalent.
+"""
+
+import math
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=64)
+def _coefficients(source: int, target: int):
+    scale = source / target
+    support = 3 * max(scale, 1.0)
+    taps = 2 * math.ceil(support) + 1
+    starts = np.empty(target, dtype=np.int32)
+    weights = np.zeros((target, taps), dtype=np.int32)
+
+    def sinc(x):
+        return 1.0 if x == 0 else math.sin(x * math.pi) / (x * math.pi)
+
+    for out in range(target):
+        center = (out + 0.5) * scale
+        start = max(0, int(center - support + 0.5))
+        end = min(source, int(center + support + 0.5))
+        values = []
+        for i in range(start, end):
+            x = (i - center + 0.5) / max(scale, 1.0)
+            values.append(sinc(x) * sinc(x / 3) if -3 <= x < 3 else 0.0)
+        total = sum(values)
+        starts[out] = start
+        for i, value in enumerate(values):
+            value = value / total if total else value
+            weights[out, i] = int(value * (1 << 22) + (-0.5 if value < 0 else 0.5))
+    return starts, weights
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=32)
+def _device_coefficients(source: int, target: int, device: int):
+    starts, weights = _coefficients(source, target)
+    return (torch.from_numpy(starts).to(device), torch.from_numpy(weights).to(device))
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["H", "W", "OW"])
+def _horizontal(
+    X,
+    Y,
+    Starts,
+    Weights,
+    H,
+    W,
+    OW,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    idx = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    valid = idx < H * OW * 3
+    c = idx % 3
+    ox = idx // 3 % OW
+    y = idx // (OW * 3)
+    start = tl.load(Starts + ox, valid, 0)
+    acc = tl.full((BLOCK,), 1 << 21, tl.int32)
+    for k in range(K):
+        weight = tl.load(Weights + ox * K + k, valid, 0)
+        pixel = tl.load(X + (y * W + start + k) * 3 + c, valid & (start + k < W), 0).to(
+            tl.int32
+        )
+        acc += pixel * weight
+    value = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(acc >> 22, 0), 255)
+    tl.store(Y + idx, value, valid)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["H", "W", "OH"])
+def _vertical_normalize(
+    X,
+    Y,
+    Starts,
+    Weights,
+    Lut,
+    H,
+    W,
+    OH,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    idx = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    valid = idx < OH * W * 3
+    c = idx % 3
+    x = idx // 3 % W
+    oy = idx // (W * 3)
+    start = tl.load(Starts + oy, valid, 0)
+    acc = tl.full((BLOCK,), 1 << 21, tl.int32)
+    for k in range(K):
+        weight = tl.load(Weights + oy * K + k, valid, 0)
+        pixel = tl.load(
+            X + ((start + k) * W + x) * 3 + c, valid & (start + k < H), 0
+        ).to(tl.int32)
+        acc += pixel * weight
+    value = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(acc >> 22, 0), 255)
+    normalized = tl.load(Lut + c * 256 + value, valid, 0)
+    tl.store(Y + c * OH * W + oy * W + x, normalized, valid)
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=32)
+def _device_lut(mean: tuple, std: tuple, device: int):
+    values = torch.arange(256, dtype=torch.float32).div_(255.0).clamp_(0.0, 1.0)
+    table = (values[None, :] - torch.tensor(mean)[:, None]) / torch.tensor(std)[:, None]
+    return table.to(device)
+
+
+def resize_normalize_gpu(
+    chw: torch.Tensor, target_h: int, target_w: int, mean: tuple, std: tuple
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Accept RGB uint8 CHW, return normalized float32 CHW on the current GPU.
+
+    CPU input incurs one uint8 H2D copy. CUDA input remains on its own device.
+    Caches are bounded; no feature tensor or request data is retained.
+    """
+    if chw.ndim != 3 or chw.shape[0] != 3 or chw.dtype != torch.uint8:
+        raise ValueError("expected RGB uint8 CHW input")
+    if target_h <= 0 or target_w <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("resize dimensions must be positive")
+    device = chw.device.index if chw.is_cuda else torch.cuda.current_device()
+    with torch.cuda.device(device):
+        h, w = chw.shape[-2:]
+        src = chw.permute(1, 2, 0).contiguous().to(device)
+        if w != target_w:
+            starts, weights = _device_coefficients(w, target_w, device)
+            intermediate = torch.empty(
+                (h, target_w, 3), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device
+            )
+            _horizontal[(triton.cdiv(intermediate.numel(), 256),)](
+                src,
+                intermediate,
+                starts,
+                weights,
+                h,
+                w,
+                target_w,
+                weights.shape[1],
+                256,
+            )
+        else:
+            intermediate = src
+        starts, weights = _device_coefficients(h, target_h, device)
+        lut = _device_lut(tuple(mean), tuple(std), device)
+        out = torch.empty((3, target_h, target_w), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        _vertical_normalize[(triton.cdiv(out.numel(), 256),)](
+            intermediate,
+            out,
+            starts,
+            weights,
+            lut,
+            h,
+            target_w,
+            target_h,
+            weights.shape[1],
+            256,
+        )
+        return out

+def _least_distortion_fit(
+    ideal_h: float,
+    ideal_w: float,
+    image_h: int,
+    image_w: int,
+    patch_size: int,
+    minimum: int,
+    maximum: int,
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    candidates = set(
+        itertools.product(
+            (math.floor(ideal_h), math.ceil(ideal_h)),
+            (math.floor(ideal_w), math.ceil(ideal_w)),
+        )
+    )
+    candidates = [
+        (height, width)
+        for height, width in candidates
+        if height > 0 and width > 0 and minimum <= height * width <= maximum
+    ]
+    if not candidates:
+        raise ValueError("no rounded resize target satisfies the token budget")
+    aspect = image_h / image_w
+    return min(candidates, key=lambda item: abs(item[0] / item[1] - aspect))

+def _least_distance_fit(
+    ideal_h: float, ideal_w: float, minimum: int, maximum: int

+        lower = math.ceil(minimum / height)
+        upper = math.floor(maximum / height)
+        if lower > upper:
+            continue
+        width = min(max(round(ideal_w), lower), upper)
+        distance = (height - ideal_h) ** 2 + (width - ideal_w) ** 2
+        if best is None or distance < best[0]:
+            best = (distance, height, width)
+    if best is None:
+        raise ValueError("no resize target satisfies the token budget")
+    return best[1], best[2]
+
+
+def find_resize_target(
+    image_h: int,
+    image_w: int,
+    patch_size: int,
+    minimum_tokens: int,
+    maximum_tokens: int,
+) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    ideal_h = image_h / patch_size
+    ideal_w = image_w / patch_size
+    ideal_count = ideal_h * ideal_w
+    aspect = ideal_w / ideal_h
+    if ideal_count > maximum_tokens:
+        ideal_h = math.sqrt(maximum_tokens / aspect)
+        ideal_w = ideal_h * aspect
+    elif ideal_count < minimum_tokens:
+        ideal_h = math.sqrt(minimum_tokens / aspect)
+        ideal_w = ideal_h * aspect
+    try:
+        patches_h, patches_w = _least_distortion_fit(
+            ideal_h,
+            ideal_w,
+            image_h,
+            image_w,
+            patch_size,
+            minimum_tokens,
+            maximum_tokens,
+        )
+    except ValueError:
+        patches_h, patches_w = _least_distance_fit(
+            ideal_h, ideal_w, minimum_tokens, maximum_tokens
+        )
+    return patches_h * patch_size, patches_w * patch_size, patches_h * patches_w
+
+
+def _image_to_uint8(
+    image: Any, *, keep_device: bool = False, channel_last: bool = False
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if isinstance(image, Image.Image):
+        array = np.array(image.convert("RGB"), copy=True)
+        return torch.from_numpy(array).permute(2, 0, 1)
+    if isinstance(image, np.ndarray):
+        value = torch.from_numpy(np.array(image, copy=True))
+        channel_last = True
+    else:
+        value = torch.as_tensor(image)
+        if not keep_device:
+            value = value.cpu()
+    if value.ndim != 3:
+        raise ValueError(f"unexpected image shape {tuple(value.shape)}")
+    if channel_last or value.shape[0] not in (1, 3, 4):
+        if value.shape[-1] not in (1, 3, 4):
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected image channel shape {tuple(value.shape)}")
+        value = value[..., :3].permute(2, 0, 1)
+    else:
+        value = value[:3]
+    if value.dtype != torch.uint8:
+        if value.is_floating_point() and value.max().item() <= 1.0:
+            value = value * 255
+        value = value.clamp(0, 255).to(torch.uint8)
+    if value.shape[0] == 1:
+        value = value.expand(3, -1, -1)
+    return value.contiguous()
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=32)
+def _normalization_lut(mean: tuple, std: tuple) -> np.ndarray:
+    # Preserve the reference float32 operation order for all 256 pixel values.
+    values = torch.arange(256, dtype=torch.float32).div_(255.0).clamp_(0.0, 1.0)
+    return (
+        (values[None, :] - torch.tensor(mean)[:, None]) / torch.tensor(std)[:, None]
+    ).numpy()
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def _rust_resize():
+    from sglang.srt.rust_extensions import load_rust_extension
+
+    try:
+        return load_rust_extension(
+            "sglang.srt.rust_extensions._multimodal", mode="never"
+        ).common.resize_rgb
+    except (ImportError, OSError, AttributeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
+        # RuntimeError covers an unusable Rust toolchain: the loader wraps the
+        # OSError from probing cargo, so mode="never" still raises here.
+        logger.debug("Muse Rust resize unavailable; using Pillow: %s", exc)
+        return None
+
+
+def _resize_and_normalize(
+    image: Any,
+    target_h: int,
+    target_w: int,
+    mean: tuple[float, float, float],
+    std: tuple[float, float, float],
+    use_rust_resize: bool = True,
+    use_gpu_preprocess: bool = False,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if use_gpu_preprocess:
+        from sglang.srt.multimodal.muse_image_processing_gpu import resize_normalize_gpu
+
+        return resize_normalize_gpu(
+            _image_to_uint8(image, keep_device=True), target_h, target_w, mean, std
+        )
+    if isinstance(image, Image.Image):
+        pil_image = image.convert("RGB")
+    else:
+        value = _image_to_uint8(image)
+        pil_image = Image.fromarray(value.permute(1, 2, 0).numpy())
+    rust_resize = _rust_resize() if use_rust_resize else None
+    if rust_resize is not None:
+        array = np.asarray(pil_image)
+        resized = rust_resize(array, target_w, target_h, "pil_lanczos")
+        array = resized.reshape(target_h, target_w, 3)
+    else:
+        array = np.asarray(
+            pil_image.resize((target_w, target_h), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+        )
+    lut = _normalization_lut(tuple(mean), tuple(std))
+    # A lookup avoids full-image float conversion and three arithmetic passes.
+    normalized = np.empty((3, target_h, target_w), dtype=np.float32)
+    for channel in range(3):
+        normalized[channel] = lut[channel, array[:, :, channel]]
+    return torch.from_numpy(normalized)
+
+
+def preprocess_image(image: Any, config: PreprocessConfig) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
+    if isinstance(image, Image.Image):
+        width, height = image.size
+        value = image
+    else:
+        value = _image_to_uint8(image, keep_device=config.use_gpu_preprocess)
+        height, width = value.shape[-2:]
+    target_h, target_w, token_count = find_resize_target(
+        height,
+        width,
+        config.token_patch_size,
+        config.min_image_tokens,
+        config.max_image_tokens,
+    )
+    return (
+        _resize_and_normalize(
+            value,
+            target_h,
+            target_w,
+            config.image_mean,
+            config.image_std,
+            config.use_rust_resize,
+            config.use_gpu_preprocess,
+        ),
+        token_count,
+    )
+
+
+def _video_frames(
+    video: Any, config: PreprocessConfig
+) -> tuple[list[Any], list[float]]:
+    if isinstance(video, tuple) and len(video) == 2:
+        frames, metadata = video
+        fps = float(metadata.get("fps", 1.0))
+        source_indices = metadata.get("frames_indices", list(range(len(frames))))
+        frames = list(frames)
+    elif isinstance(video, torch.Tensor) and video.ndim == 4:
+        frames = list(video)
+        fps = 1.0
+        source_indices = list(range(len(frames)))
+    else:
+        # Decoder-like input (e.g. torchcodec): len() and avg_fps are
+        # metadata, so select the sampled indices first and decode only those
+        # frames instead of decoding every frame.
+        total = len(video)
+        if total == 0:
+            raise ValueError("video input has no frames")
+        try:
+            fps = float(video.avg_fps)
+        except Exception:
+            fps = 1.0
+        if not math.isfinite(fps) or fps <= 0:
+            logger.warning("Invalid video FPS %r; falling back to 1.0", fps)
+            fps = 1.0
+        factor = max(config.frame_factor, config.patch_temporal)
+        if config.sampling_fps and fps > 0:
+            requested = int(total * config.sampling_fps / fps)
+        else:
+            requested = total
+        requested = min(max(requested, factor), config.num_frames_per_video, total)
+        requested = max(factor, requested // factor * factor)
+        if total > requested:
+            selected = torch.linspace(0, total - 1, requested).long().tolist()
+        else:
+            selected = list(range(total))
+        frames = [video[index] for index in selected]
+        # VideoDecoderWrapper returns HWC even for CUDA tensors. Preserve that
+        # contract instead of guessing from heights that can be 1, 3, or 4.
+        if isinstance(video, VideoDecoderWrapper):
+            frames = [
+                _image_to_uint8(
+                    frame, keep_device=config.use_gpu_preprocess, channel_last=True
+                )
+                for frame in frames
+            ]
+        source_indices = list(selected)
+        while len(frames) < factor:
+            frames.append(frames[-1])
+            source_indices.append(source_indices[-1])
+        if not frames:
+            raise ValueError("video input has no frames")
+        return frames, [float(index) / fps for index in source_indices]
+    if not frames:
+        raise ValueError("video input has no frames")
+    if len(source_indices) != len(frames):
+        raise ValueError("frames_indices must align with the supplied video frames")
+    if not math.isfinite(fps) or fps <= 0:
+        logger.warning("Invalid video FPS %r; falling back to 1.0", fps)
+        fps = 1.0
+
+    factor = max(config.frame_factor, config.patch_temporal)
+    if config.sampling_fps and fps > 0:
+        # Indices refer to the original video, not to the sampled frame list.
+        source_span = source_indices[-1] - source_indices[0] + 1
+        if source_span <= 0 or any(
+            right < left for left, right in zip(source_indices, source_indices[1:])
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("frames_indices must be nondecreasing")
+        requested = int(source_span * config.sampling_fps / fps)
+    else:
+        requested = len(frames)
+    requested = min(max(requested, factor), config.num_frames_per_video, len(frames))
+    requested = max(factor, requested // factor * factor)
+    if len(frames) > requested:
+        selected = torch.linspace(0, len(frames) - 1, requested).long().tolist()
+        frames = [frames[index] for index in selected]
+        source_indices = [source_indices[index] for index in selected]
+    while len(frames) < factor:
+        frames.append(frames[-1])
+        source_indices.append(source_indices[-1])
+    aligned = len(frames) // factor * factor
+    frames = frames[:aligned]
+    source_indices = source_indices[:aligned]
+    return frames, [float(index) / fps for index in source_indices]
+
+
+def preprocess_video(video: Any, config: PreprocessConfig) -> VideoFeatures:
+    frames, timestamps = _video_frames(video, config)
+    first = _image_to_uint8(frames[0], keep_device=config.use_gpu_preprocess)
+    height, width = first.shape[-2:]
+    if config.use_per_video_token_budget:
+        num_clips = max(1, len(frames) // config.patch_temporal)
+        per_video_maximum = config.max_video_tokens // num_clips
+        if per_video_maximum < config.min_image_tokens:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "max_video_tokens cannot satisfy min_image_tokens for every clip"
+            )
+        maximum = per_video_maximum
+        if config.max_tokens_per_frame > 0:
+            maximum = min(maximum, config.max_tokens_per_frame)
+    elif config.max_tokens_per_frame > 0:
+        maximum = config.max_tokens_per_frame
+    else:
+        maximum = config.max_video_tokens
+    target_h, target_w, patches_per_clip = find_resize_target(
+        height,
+        width,
+        config.token_patch_size,
+        config.min_image_tokens,
+        maximum,
+    )
+    tensor = torch.stack(
+        [
+            _resize_and_normalize(
+                frame,
+                target_h,
+                target_w,
+                config.image_mean,
+                config.image_std,
+                config.use_rust_resize,
+                config.use_gpu_preprocess,
+            )
+            for frame in frames
+        ]
+    )
+    clip_timestamps = timestamps[:: config.patch_temporal]
+    return VideoFeatures(tensor, patches_per_clip, clip_timestamps)
+
+
+def preprocess_audio(
+    audio: Any, samples_per_token: int = AUDIO_SAMPLES_PER_TOKEN
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
+    value = torch.as_tensor(audio, dtype=torch.float32)
+    if value.ndim > 1:
+        value = value.mean(dim=0)
+    value = value.flatten()
+    return value, math.ceil(value.numel() / samples_per_token)
+
+
+def _load_video_processor_config(
+    model_path: str, revision: Optional[str]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    config_file = cached_file(
+        resolve_runai_obj_uri(model_path),
+        "processor_config.json",
+        revision=revision,
+        # None when the checkpoint has no processor_config.json.
+        _raise_exceptions_for_missing_entries=False,
+    )
+    if config_file is None:
+        return {}
+    with open(config_file) as f:
+        video = json.load(f).get("video_processor", {})
+    return {
+        field: video[key]
+        for key, field in _VIDEO_PROCESSOR_FIELDS.items()
+        if key in video
+    }
+
+
+def make_preprocess_config(vision) -> PreprocessConfig:
+    return PreprocessConfig(
+        use_rust_resize=resolve_image_processor_backend(get_mm()) != "pil",
+        patch_size=vision.patch_size,
+        patch_temporal=vision.patch_temporal,
+        downsample_factor=vision.merge_size,
+        **_load_video_processor_config(
+            model_path=get_model().model_path, revision=get_model().revision
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def build_encoder_inputs(mm_data, modality, config, samples_per_token):
+    """Use colocated preprocessing and send output grids alongside embeddings."""
+    items, grids, features, timestamps = [], [], [], []
+    for value in mm_data:
+        if modality == Modality.IMAGE:
+            feature, count = preprocess_image(value, config)
+            grid = [
+                1,
+                feature.shape[-2] // config.token_patch_size,
+                feature.shape[-1] // config.token_patch_size,
+            ]
+        elif modality == Modality.VIDEO:
+            video = preprocess_video(value, config)
+            feature = video.tensor
+            grid = [
+                len(video.timestamps),
+                feature.shape[-2] // config.token_patch_size,
+                feature.shape[-1] // config.token_patch_size,
+            ]
+            timestamps.append(video.timestamps)
+        elif modality == Modality.AUDIO:
+            feature, grid = preprocess_audio(value, samples_per_token)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Muse encoder modality: {modality}")
+        features.append(feature)
+        grids.append(grid)
+        items.append(MultimodalDataItem(modality=modality, feature=feature))
+    grid_key, feature_key = {
+        Modality.IMAGE: ("image_grid_thw", "pixel_values"),
+        Modality.VIDEO: ("video_grid_thw", "pixel_values_videos"),
+        Modality.AUDIO: ("audio_feature_lens_raw", "input_features"),
+    }[modality]
+    values = {grid_key: torch.tensor(grids, dtype=torch.long), feature_key: features}
+    if modality == Modality.VIDEO:
+        values["video_timestamps"] = timestamps
+    return EncoderPreprocessOutput(values, mm_items=items)
+
+
+def _token_id(tokenizer, token: str) -> int:
+    token_id = None
+    if hasattr(tokenizer, "convert_tokens_to_ids"):
+        token_id = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(token)
+    encoding = getattr(tokenizer, "tokenizer", tokenizer)
+    special_tokens = getattr(encoding, "_special_tokens", {})
+    token_id = special_tokens.get(token, token_id)
+    if token_id is None or token_id == getattr(tokenizer, "unk_token_id", None):
+        encoded = _encode(tokenizer, token)
+        if len(encoded) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"tokenizer does not define required token {token!r}")
+        token_id = encoded[0]
+    return int(token_id)
+
+
+def _optional_token_id(tokenizer, token: str) -> Optional[int]:
+    """Resolve a special token by name, or None when the tokenizer lacks it.
+
+    Deliberately name-driven with no id constants: the delimiter ids are a
+    function of the tokenizer's special-token ordering, so hardcoding them
+    would silently produce wrong ids on any checkpoint whose vocab differs.
+    Returning None keeps the decision at the use site, which rejects audio
+    with a clear error rather than encoding tokens the model cannot consume.
+    """
+    try:
+        return _token_id(tokenizer, token)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _encode(tokenizer, text: str) -> list[int]:
+    try:
+        return list(tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False))
+    except TypeError:
+        return list(tokenizer.encode(text, allowed_special="all"))
+
+
+def _image_replacement(token_count: int) -> str:
+    return "<|image_start|>" + "<|patch|>" * token_count + "<|image_end|>"
+
+
+def _replace_once(text: str, placeholder: str, replacement: str) -> str:
+    if placeholder not in text:
+        raise ValueError(f"missing {placeholder!r} placeholder for supplied media")
+    return text.replace(placeholder, replacement, 1)
+
+
+def _expand_raw_placeholders(tokenizer, ids, placeholder, pattern, replacements):
+    """Replace raw markers once, preserving token IDs outside their boundaries."""
+    text = tokenizer.decode(ids)
+    count = text.count(placeholder)
+    if count > len(replacements):
+        raise ValueError(f"more {placeholder!r} placeholders than supplied media")
+    if not count:
+        return ids, 0
+
+    # Most templates encode each marker as its own token sequence.
+    starts = [
+        i
+        for i in range(len(ids) - len(pattern) + 1)
+        if ids[i : i + len(pattern)] == pattern
+    ]
+    if len(starts) == count:
+        output, cursor = [], 0
+        for start, replacement in zip(starts, replacements):
+            output.extend(ids[cursor:start])
+            output.extend(replacement)
+            cursor = start + len(pattern)
+        output.extend(ids[cursor:])
+        return output, count
+
+    # BPE may merge a marker with adjacent text. Decode each token only once,
+    # then re-encode only boundary fragments; never scan generated patch tokens.
+    parts = [tokenizer.decode([token_id]) for token_id in ids]
+    text = "".join(parts)
+    offsets = [0]
+    for part in parts:
+        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + len(part))
+
+    def append_text(start, end):
+        if start == end:
+            return
+        first = bisect_right(offsets, start) - 1
+        last = bisect_left(offsets, end) - 1
+        if first == last:
+            if start == offsets[first] and end == offsets[first + 1]:
+                output.append(ids[first])
+            else:
+                output.extend(_encode(tokenizer, text[start:end]))
+            return
+        if start != offsets[first]:
+            output.extend(_encode(tokenizer, text[start : offsets[first + 1]]))
+            first += 1
+        output.extend(ids[first:last])
+        if end == offsets[last + 1]:
+            output.append(ids[last])
+        else:
+            output.extend(_encode(tokenizer, text[offsets[last] : end]))
+
+    output, cursor, consumed = [], 0, 0
+    for match in re.finditer(re.escape(placeholder), text):
+        if consumed == len(replacements):
+            raise ValueError(f"more {placeholder!r} placeholders than supplied media")
+        append_text(cursor, match.start())
+        output.extend(replacements[consumed])
+        consumed += 1
+        cursor = match.end()
+    append_text(cursor, len(text))
+    return output, consumed
+
+
+def _find_runs(
+    input_ids: list[int], token_id: int, expected_lengths: list[list[int]]
+) -> list[list[tuple[int, int]]]:
+    runs = []
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(input_ids):
+        if input_ids[index] != token_id:
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        end = index + 1
+        while end < len(input_ids) and input_ids[end] == token_id:
+            end += 1
+        runs.append((index, end - 1))
+        index = end
+    flattened_expected = [length for group in expected_lengths for length in group]
+    actual_lengths = [end - start + 1 for start, end in runs]
+    if actual_lengths != flattened_expected:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"multimodal token runs {actual_lengths} do not match features "
+            f"{flattened_expected}"
+        )
+    grouped = []
+    cursor = 0
+    for lengths in expected_lengths:
+        grouped.append(runs[cursor : cursor + len(lengths)])
+        cursor += len(lengths)
+    return grouped
+
+
+def _replace_unexpanded_hf_markers(parts, replacements, boundaries):
+    """Normalize HF template markers while preserving already expanded media."""
+    result = []
+    end = None
+    for part in parts:
+        if end is not None:
+            result.append(part)
+            if part == end:
+                end = None
+        elif part in boundaries:
+            end = boundaries[part]
+            result.append(part)
+        else:
+            result.extend(replacements.get(part, [part]))
+    return result
+

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MuseImagePreprocessArtifact:
+    content_digest: str
+    artifact_key: str
+    feature_hash: int
+    feature: torch.Tensor
+    token_count: int
+    cpu_feature: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+
+    @property
+    def has_feature(self) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    def cache_value(self):
+        if self.feature.device.type == "cpu":
+            return self
+        # The IO worker prepares this copy. Never synchronize D2H on the
+        # tokenizer event loop, or make a miss request upload the copy again.
+        assert self.cpu_feature is not None and self.cpu_feature.device.type == "cpu"
+        return replace(self, feature=self.cpu_feature, cpu_feature=None)
+
+    def cache_size_items(self):
+        return (
+            self.content_digest,
+            self.artifact_key,
+            self.feature_hash,
+            self.feature,
+            self.token_count,
+        )

+class MuseSpark1xOmniMultimodalProcessor(
+    MediaArtifactCacheMixin, BaseMultimodalProcessor
+):
+    models = [MuseSparkForConditionalGeneration]
+    gpu_image_decode = False
+    # Decode on CPU even when optional GPU resizing is enabled. Decoder worker
+    # threads otherwise create a context on the default GPU before the explicit
+    # base_gpu_id preprocessing context is entered.
+    video_preprocessing_device = "cpu"
+    artifact_modality = Modality.IMAGE
+    auto_mm_preprocess_cache_size_mb = 256
+
+    def __init__(self, hf_config, server_args, _processor, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(hf_config, server_args, _processor, *args, **kwargs)
+        self.audio_samples_per_token = math.prod(hf_config.audio_config.patch_sizes)
+        vision = hf_config.vision_config
+        self.preprocess_config = make_preprocess_config(vision)

+        tokenizer = self._tokenizer
+        self.image_start_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|image_start|>")
+        self.image_end_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|image_end|>")
+        self.patch_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|patch|>")
+        self.video_start_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|vid_start|>")
+        self.video_end_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|vid_end|>")
+        self.video_separator_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|vid_frame_separator|>")
+        self.video_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|video|>")
+        self.audio_id = _token_id(tokenizer, "<|audio|>")

+        # soft-audio delimiters as reserved placeholders. Treat them as optional so
+        # a text/image/video server still starts; audio input fails loudly instead.
+        self.audio_start_id = _optional_token_id(tokenizer, "<|soft_audio_start|>")
+        self.audio_end_id = _optional_token_id(tokenizer, "<|soft_audio_end|>")
+        self.audio_supported = (
+            self.audio_start_id is not None and self.audio_end_id is not None
+        )
+        if not self.audio_supported:
+            logger.warning(
+                "Tokenizer does not define <|soft_audio_start|>/<|soft_audio_end|>; "
+                "audio input is disabled for this checkpoint. In the published "
+                "release these two delimiters are still named as reserved "
+                "placeholders (ids 201463 and 201464). To enable audio, serve a "
+                "copy of the tokenizer with those two entries renamed, passed "
+                "via --tokenizer-path."
+            )

+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    _wait_for_gpu_idle_in_ci,
+    is_in_ci,
+    try_cached_model,
+    write_github_step_summary,
+)
+
+# ci-cost-override: the 816B checkpoint needs two TP4 replicas; one full GSM8K
+# pass covers both NVLink PD transfer and the DFlash2 acceptance regression gate.
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=900, stage="base-c", runner_config="8-gpu-b300")
+
+MODEL_PATH = "meta-models/Muse-Spark-1.2-816B-A42B-NVFP4-open"
+DRAFT_MODEL_PATH = "RadixArk/Muse-Spark-1.2-DFlash2-preview"
+SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT = 3600
+MOONCAKE_ENV = {
+    "MC_INTRANODE_NVLINK": "true",
+    "MC_TCP_ENABLE_CONNECTION_POOL": "true",
+    "SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL": "INTRA_NODE_NVLINK",
+}
+
+
+class TestMuseSpark12B300PD(PDDisaggregationServerBase):
+    gsm8k_accuracy_thres = 0.93
+    accept_length_thres = 3.5
+    prefill_tp_size = 4
+    decode_tp_size = 4
+    # CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES remaps decode GPUs 4-7 to local ordinals 0-3.
+    decode_base_gpu_id = 0
+    extra_prefill_env = {**MOONCAKE_ENV, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0,1,2,3"}
+    extra_decode_env = {**MOONCAKE_ENV, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "4,5,6,7"}
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        cls.model = try_cached_model(MODEL_PATH)
+        cls.transfer_backend = ["--disaggregation-transfer-backend", "mooncake"]
+        common_args = [
+            # FlashInfer 0.6.18 autotuning uses unresized per-token FP4 scales.
+            "--disable-flashinfer-autotune",
+            "--quantization",
+            "modelopt_fp4",
+            "--moe-runner-backend",
+            "flashinfer_trtllm",
+            "--ep-size",
+            "4",
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "trtllm_mha",
+            "--page-size",
+            "128",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.8",
+            "--reasoning-parser",
+            "muse",
+            "--tool-call-parser",
+            "muse",
+            "--speculative-algorithm",
+            "DFLASH",
+            "--speculative-draft-model-path",
+            try_cached_model(DRAFT_MODEL_PATH),
+            "--speculative-draft-attention-backend",
+            "fa4",
+            "--speculative-num-draft-tokens",
+            "8",
+        ]
+        cls.extra_prefill_args = [
+            *common_args,
+            "--enable-layernorm-sp",
+            "--enable-megamoe-for-layernorm-sp",
+            "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
+            "--hicache-size",
+            "200",
+        ]
+        cls.extra_decode_args = [*common_args, "--max-total-tokens", "4545536"]
+        cls.launch_all()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def rdma_devices_for(cls, gpu_indices):
+        # This recipe transfers within one node over NVLink, not an RDMA NIC.
+        return []
+
+    @classmethod
+    def wait_server_ready(cls, url, timeout=SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT, process=None):
+        super().wait_server_ready(url, timeout=timeout, process=process)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        super().tearDownClass()
+        _wait_for_gpu_idle_in_ci(timeout=120)
+
+    def test_gsm8k(self):
+        for url in (self.prefill_url, self.decode_url):
+            requests.post(f"{url}/flush_cache", timeout=60).raise_for_status()
+
+        # The completion-style few-shot evaluator removes its prompt examples
+        # from the test split. Chat evaluation retains all 1,319 test questions.
+        metrics = run_eval(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                base_url=self.base_url,
+                model=self.model,
+                eval_name="gsm8k",
+                api="sgl_eval",
+                num_examples=None,
+                num_threads=64,
+                sgl_eval_thinking=True,
+                reasoning_effort="xhigh",
+                max_tokens=32768,
+                temperature=1.0,
+                top_p=0.95,
+            )
+        )
+        result = json.loads(Path(metrics["sgl_eval_metrics_path"]).read_text())
+        self.assertEqual(result["num_examples"], 1319)
+        self.assertEqual(result["n_repeats"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics["error_rate"], 0.0)
+
+        # Read the decode endpoint explicitly; missing speculative metrics must
+        # fail this test rather than silently bypass the acceptance threshold.
+        response = requests.get(f"{self.decode_url}/server_info", timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        states = response.json()["internal_states"]
+        self.assertTrue(states)
+        accept_length = states[0]["avg_spec_accept_length"]
+        print(
+            f"GSM8K: {metrics['score']:.4f}, avg_spec_accept_length={accept_length:.4f}"
+        )
+        if is_in_ci():
+            write_github_step_summary(
+                f"### Muse Spark 1.2 NVFP4 1P1D\n"
+                f"GSM8K (1319): {metrics['score']:.4f}\n"
+                f"avg_spec_accept_length: {accept_length:.4f}\n"
+            )
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(metrics["score"], self.gsm8k_accuracy_thres)
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(accept_length, self.accept_length_thres)
+
